TEXT: Meet Billy – The Quiet Charmer with a Playful Side 🎾🐾 Billy is a gentle, independent greyhound with a lovely calm nature and just the right amount of playfulness. He’s not one to demand constant attention, but he’s always nearby with a quiet presence and a soft heart. Billy gets along beautifully with small dogs and is respectful and friendly in their company. He also enjoys a bit of solo playtime with his toys – give him a squeaky or something to toss around, and he’s one happy hound. This laid-back boy values his own space and is content to relax on his own, making him a great companion for someone who appreciates a more independent pet. He’s the kind of dog who slots effortlessly into your routine without any fuss.

NAME: Pheonix
TEXT: Meet Phoenix – The Laid-Back Legend with a Love for Pats 🚐🐾 Phoenix is a cool, confident greyhound who takes life in his stride – quite literally! He walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys a good stroll by your side, always calm and well-mannered. This clever boy is also super practical – he can hop in and out of a van all by himself, making outings and adventures a breeze. Whether it’s a trip to the park or a drive to somewhere new, Phoenix is always up for the ride. Phoenix is a big fan of affection and never says no to a pat or a gentle scratch – he’ll happily lean in for more! He’s also friendly with other dogs and enjoys their company, making him a great fit for homes with existing pets.

NAME: Greg
TEXT: Meet Greg – A Gentle Soul Ready to Bloom 🌟🐾 Greg is a sweet and sensitive greyhound with a quietly charming personality. He can be a little shy at first, but it doesn’t take long for him to warm up – and once he does, you’ll see a loving and loyal companion who enjoys being part of the action in his own gentle way. Greg gets along well with other dogs and enjoys their company. He walks beautifully on the lead and is a dream to take out and about, always calm and well-mannered. He also travels well in the car, making adventures easy and stress-free. With a little patience and a lot of love, Greg will continue to come out of his shell and show you just how affectionate and easy going he really is. He’s a quiet star who’s just waiting for the right person or family to help him shine.

NAME: Sheila
TEXT: Meet Sheila – A Sweet Soul with a Playful Heart 🐾💖 Sheila is a beautiful greyhound with a gentle nature and a heart full of love. She can be a little shy when meeting new people or exploring new places, but give her a bit of time and patience, and you’ll see her blossom into a joyful, playful girl with the happiest little tail wags. Once Sheila feels safe and settled, her playful side shines through. She loves to run, bounce around, and enjoy the company of her doggy friends – she gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in their company. Sheila would do best in a calm and supportive home where she’s given the space to build her confidence. In return, she’ll reward you with sweet affection, gentle playfulness, and a loyal heart.

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Meet Penny – The Playful Ball-Chasing Queen! 🎾🐾 Penny is a bright, bubbly greyhound with a zest for life and a serious love for fetch! Toss a ball and watch her light up with joy – she could play all day if you let her. Her playful spirit and happy nature make her an absolute delight to be around. Always cheerful and full of personality, Penny brings positive energy wherever she goes. She travels well in the car, making her a great companion for outings and adventures, and she’s perfectly content relaxing in her crate when it’s time to wind down. Penny is the perfect mix of fun and easy going. Whether she’s chasing a ball, enjoying a ride, or snoozing in her crate after a busy day, she does it all with a wagging tail and a happy heart.

NAME: Glen
TEXT: Meet Glen – The Ultimate Companion with a Heart of Gold 💛🐾 Glen is a handsome greyhound with a big heart and an even bigger love for life. Friendly, affectionate, and full of charm, Glen adores people and never misses an opportunity for a cuddle or a kind word. His tail is always wagging, especially when he's surrounded by his favourite humans. Glen gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is a real social butterfly. Whether he's playing with his pals or just chilling nearby, he brings calm, friendly energy wherever he goes. A big fan of toys, Glen loves a bit of playtime and will happily keep himself entertained with a squeaky or two. He also travels like a dream in the car, making him the perfect buddy for road trips, weekend getaways, or even just a quick drive to the park.

NAME: Donnie
TEXT: Meet Donnie – The Social Butterfly with a Love for Fun! 🐶🎾 Donnie is a happy-go-lucky greyhound who’s always up for a good time! Whether he’s heading out on a road trip or making new doggy friends at the park, Donnie takes it all in stride. He travels like a pro – calm, relaxed, and ready for the next stop on the journey. This playful boy has a soft spot for toys and will happily entertain himself with a squeaky or a tug toy, bringing a smile to everyone around him. He gets along wonderfully with other dogs and thrives in social settings, making him a great fit for families with existing canine companions. Donnie walks beautifully on the lead and loves exploring the world at a comfortable pace by your side. His friendly nature, confidence, and zest for life make him a joy to have around.

NAME: Dougall
TEXT: Meet Dougall – Your Future Travel Buddy! 🚗🐾 Dougall is a charming greyhound with a heart as big as his love for car rides. This gentle soul is always ready to hop in the car and join you on your next adventure – whether it’s a weekend getaway or just a trip to the shops, Dougall’s happy place is right by your side. With excellent leash manners, Dougall walks beautifully on the lead, making strolls a breeze. He’s polite and friendly around other dogs, and his calm nature makes him a wonderful companion in a variety of settings. Dougall also has a soft spot for affection. He’ll happily lean in for a cuddle or nuzzle up for some ear scratches – he may be sleek and speedy, but he’s really just a big softie at heart.

NAME: Obi Wan Kenobi
TEXT: This is Obi-Wan Kenobi, a brave Jedi knight. He harnesses the use of the force to steal hearts across the adoption centre. What do we love about Obi? Read on... Obi-Wan Kenobi gets super excited and might even do a little happy dance when he sees his lead as he loves walkies and adventures, making him a great fit for an adventurous family who enjoy long walks through the galaxy. He is perfect indoors with no accidents here at the GAP adoption centre. His preferred home would be a house with some yard space as he enjoys the freedom to do as he pleases! If you're looking for a cutie to binge some Star Wars eps with, Obi-Wan Kenobi might be the perfect fit. He is gentle, affectionate and loves lazing on the couch and has the quintessential greyhound personality of lazy bones mixed with moments of playfulness. Obi-Wan Kenobi seeks a family who will respect his Jedi calmness but also embrace his playful side. He’s suited for homes with a peaceful vibe and a little space to run free like a Rebel. Meet Obi at the Western Sydney adoption centre and "May the paws be with you"!

NAME: Opal (Western Sydney)
TEXT: This sparkling 3-year-old Opal is a cute little guy looking for a new place to call home. Opal has zest for life that can be paralleled by none! The perfect low maintenance dog, Opal doesn’t ask for much except for a nice cozy bed to nap in, some quality ear scratches and a little walk when you get home from work! He is hoping his new home is in a quieter area, maybe some respectful children to play with, and a yard big enough for some sniffing around. Opal doesn't mind digging into a crate, but not required! He can walk up and down stairs too, so townhouse living or adventures out and about are fine by him! Excavate this precious and valuable Opal today! Submit an application to take him home. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Frankie
TEXT: This gorgeous boy is looking for his new home! Meet Frankie 🐾 Frankie is a sweet boy, that can be a little shy at first, but is very friendly and affectionate once he's given some time and a chance to warm up! Frankie is friendly with other medium to large dogs, so pending a meet and greet, could suit a home with another dog of a similar size. A family that can guide Frankie through his new life with lots of love is just what he needs! Meet Frankie at Western Sydney 😊

NAME: Rocky (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Rocky, the underdog coming through to take the spotlight of a home! This boy has no trouble leading his way through our kennels to find his next victory. Rocky is a very handsome lad that doesn’t mind spending time with children and frolicking in a backyard/townhouse as he has experience around kids. Rocky would walk best on a harness as he is excited to get going. Rocky is available to adopt from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Zingy
TEXT: Hello, I'm Zingy! I'm a happy, vibrant, fun loving girl. I like playing with toys and would be fun for a family with respectful children to entertain! I would enjoy a backyard or townhouse to bounce around. I don't mind settling down in a crate but I don't need one to be happy. I would love to thrive in a supportive home who enjoys my fun loving side but also happy to take it easy with me as I love to snooze for my 18 hours of beauty sleep! You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Fig
TEXT: Say hello to our adorable Fig! Fig is a certified people-person in dog form who thrives on attention, affection, and the occasional belly rub. If you’re home more often than not, Fig will be your best friend, your cuddle buddy, and your biggest fan. He’s got great recall and walks like a dream on the leash, so he’s always up for a stroll, as long as it’s by your side. Figgy is hoping his new owner has a backyard for him for zoomies & to take a nap on the grass in the sunshine. Playful and full of life, Figgy boy loves to let loose in a yard. He gets on well with other medium/large dogs and older kids are also fine by him. Dress ups, fun and games are all his cup of tea. He will have the kids entertained all day. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who’s as happy sprinting as he is snuggling, Figgy might be your perfect match. If Fig sounds just simply delicious to you, apply to adopt online today!

NAME: Lucy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: If you're looking for a little lap dog in the shape of a greyhound this winter, look no further than Lucy. Her photos say it all, she will literally sit in your lap if you let her! She is completely content around new people, and thrives on attention and fun. Don't be fooled, she's still a lazy greyhound at heart and will sunbake the day away once you've had some play and cuddles. She is super friendly, excitable and affectionate. She would thrive in a busy, active home who can give her snuggles and play time. She has lovely human focus, so will be easy to train, as she has a very eager to please personality. We'd recommend older/experience kids for Lucy as she is quite the bouncy girl! Lucy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Elle
TEXT: Confident and affectionate girl Elle will slot into your life like she's always been there. She is an easy going girl who is happy, bright and spirited. Her experience with kids and her easy going nature around other M-L dogs will see her fit effortlessly into a family home. Elle would prefer a backyard to romp around and would enjoy a bustling family life! Elle is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Irene
TEXT: Irene is a sweet and polite girl who is eager to please, she has shown she loves food and responding well to training. She doesn't mind some hours alone on her own and shows to cope well in quiet situations where she can get her beauty sleep. She likes to play with other dogs when put with her fellow greyhound buddies, so if you're looking for a play mate for your dog Irene would be a great fit. Due to her gentle nature, she would suit respectful kiddos. Irene is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Horsey
TEXT: Horsey is an incredible work of art. He is a sculpted magnificent looking retired athlete. He does enjoy a play and a run. He does wipe out pretty quick like most sprinters once he has moved and will relax nicely. He is a gentle boy who loves everyone, he is a social and confident boy. He is currently in foster care in a suburban area.

NAME: Chester
TEXT: Chester is a strapping boy, he is calm and confident. He is comfortable in the yard on his own and can be left alone. He knows his name and comes when called. He is very trainable and compliant. He is very patient and comfortable on the lead and is comfortable being walked in busy areas/noisy roads etc.

NAME: Fab
TEXT: *Fab is in a foster care home with another female greyhound* Foster Care Update: Fab has settled in well and loving life with her new greyhound foster sister. She has really gained confidence, has mastered the doggy door and going up stairs of up to 8 with confidence. She is still working on descending larger stairs. She hasn't had any accidents in the house in over a week now, as she is now using the doggy door when she needs to go outside. She loves a cuddle and a pat and will happily snuggle up with us on the bed (but only if we pick her up to put her on there, she won't jump up herself). ------ Fab is a gentle, calm and laid back girl. She settles well indoors, and would be happy to live along side you in an apartment. She is polite and gentle around smaller breeds of dogs as well as greyhounds and would suit a home with another dog due to her wonderful manners. This little lady might be middle aged but she loves to have a little play. Fab walks nicely on the lead but won't ask for long walkies, shorter trots around the block are enough for her. Fab is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Stavros
TEXT: Stavros is a beautiful boy that’s full of love and life! He has spent the last few months in a foster care home with 6 other dogs of all shapes and sizes. This makes him the perfect addition to a new home that may already have a dog at home. Stavros would be best suited to a home with 1 other doggie friend. 6 was fun, but he's about quality, not quantity! If Stavros lives as your only dog, shorter hours alone are preferred. With a doggie pal to keep him company, you can go off to work during the day and he'll be happy with the canine company he has. Stavros is fond of a run around and play time but also loves giving and receiving lots of affection. An adults only home is the best fit for this gentle giant. He has a playful side and loves to have fun! Stavros would be a great addition to an apartment home with an active lifestyle, or a house with a yard. He's got a great food drive which has seen him learn many tricks including walking up and down stairs! Stavros is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Nina
TEXT: Meet Nina! Nina currently lives with other Greyhounds so she wouldn't mind sharing her new home with another medium to large canine. She has also shown some positive interactions with small dogs, so pending a meet and greet, she could potentially enjoy sharing her space with a canine friend on the smaller side. Nina is confident, friendly and loves to engage with all the humans she meets! She can't wait to bring lots of fun and affection into the lives of her new family. Come and meet Nina down at Western Sydney!

NAME: Skipper
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Skipper! 🐾 Skipper is a lovable goofball with a huge heart. His silly antics and gentle soul truly win people over. Whether he’s prancing around the yard with a toy in his mouth, flopping onto his bed for a nap, or leaning in for a cuddle, Skipper brings joy and laughter to every moment. He’s the kind of dog who makes you smile just by being himself. Skipper would be a great family dog, he adores kids and is great with other dogs big and small. He would be lucky addition to any dog loving household!

NAME: Darth
TEXT: Darth has been mingling with his sight hound cousins, whippets, and is ready to join your crew! Darth is a confident, social and bubbly boy, who loves treats and all things fun. Darth could easily fit into a multi-dog household due to growing up with whippets. He has moments of high energy so older kids and a backyard are best suited to Darth. This cutie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Candy
TEXT: Do you have a sweet tooth? Candy might be just what you need! This gorgeous girl is a little shy but with some time and patience to warm up to her new family, she'll show you just how sweet she is. Candy gets along well with other dogs, big and small, so pending a meet and greet, she wouldn't mind going home with another dog of any size! In fact, a new canine bestie might be just the thing to help Candy settle well into her new home. Come down to Western Sydney to meet Candy, she may just make your life a whole lot sweeter 🐾🍭

NAME: Buddy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Buddy🐾 I'm a beautiful blue boy, looking for a place to call home and can't wait to be a part of your life! Confidence is key with me, I like to show how friendly I am when I engage with the new humans I meet along the way. I'm a pretty easy going guy, toys and treats are definitely the way to my heart! I get along well with other medium to large dogs, so I wouldn't mind meeting another canine friend to possibly share my new home with. If you think I might be the guy for you, come and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Lylah
TEXT: Meet Lylah! This sweet girl is ready to be the next new addition to your family! Lylah is super friendly and oozes confidence with all the new humans she meets when she's out and about. Pending a meet a greet, Lylah wouldn't mind sharing her new home with a canine friend as she currently lives with another Greyhound and has shown to get along well with other dogs, big and small! Lylah enjoys her walks and loves to engage in some affection with her human friends, showing she's ready to bring lots of fun and love into your life. Meet Lylah down at Western Sydney!

NAME: Uno
TEXT: Uno is a sweet-natured, gentle girl with a calm and placid demeanor. She may be a little shy at first, but with patience and a supportive home, she’ll blossom beautifully. Uno does well with kind, understanding children and gets along with smaller dogs. With a slow and careful introduction, she may also do well with cats. Uno is looking for a calm, nurturing environment where she can continue to grow in confidence and love.

NAME: Champ
TEXT: Champ is a bright, playful boy with a big heart and an even bigger personality. He’s incredibly smart, curious, and always ready to engage with the world around him. Sweet and affectionate, Champ loves spending time with people and is great with children. He gets along well with small dogs and enjoys active playtime. Champ does have some special requirements, so he’s looking for a loving home that can meet his unique needs and help him thrive.

NAME: Winnie
TEXT: Winnie is a gentle, sweet-natured girl with a heart full of love. She can be a little shy at first, but once she feels safe, her affectionate and loving personality shines through. Winnie thrives with a companion—whether human or another friendly dog—and would do best in a home where she’s not alone too often. She’s great with children, friendly with small dogs, and with a slow, patient introduction, she can get along well with cats too. Winnie is ready to find her forever family who will give her the love and reassurance she deserves.

NAME: Simone
TEXT: This pretty girl may come across a bit shy at first, however she warms up pretty quick and is a sucker for cuddles and affection. She would suit most environments, she plays well with dogs of all sizes and can relax on her own while your not home. She is a nice walker on the lead and good company.

NAME: Ester
TEXT: Ester may have just celebrated her 10th birthday, but this sweet, gentle lady still has so much love to give! Ester has spent some time in a unit apartment foster care home. A well-mannered, affectionate soul, she adores the company of other greyhounds and is open to meeting new friends with a proper introduction—especially other medium or large breeds. Ester’s ideal day includes lounging on a comfy pillow, taking a leisurely walk, and enjoying quiet moments with her humans. Though she’s an “older” gal, Ester still has plenty of spunk and would love a calm, loving home to call her own. She’s the perfect companion for someone looking for a loyal, relaxed dog to share their home, maybe couch, and life’s simple pleasures. Ester is ready to fill your heart with the kind of love only a senior dog can bring—gentle, kind, and full of gratitude. Could you be the one to offer Ester the forever home she deserves? If you’re ready to make her golden years the best yet, come meet this sweet lady today. She’s waiting to shower you with love! 🐾💕

NAME: Roman
TEXT: Roman is a striking young pup with a truly unique feature – his regal Roman nose! This handsome boy is still full of puppy charm: goofy, curious, and loves his cuddles. While he may be a little shy when meeting new people, he warms up quickly and is eager to make friends. Roman loves going on walks, especially with the 7- and 11-year-old kids he’s been spending time with – he's learning not to jump up in excitement, but he's already very good on the lead. He’s also a big fan of car rides, hydrobaths, and outdoor adventures, and he loves romping around with his brothers. He’s has sniffed the household cat and Maltese but ignores them, making him a great candidate for growing up in a multi-pet home with gradual introductions. He is good with other greyhounds. Roman is best suited to an experienced dog or greyhound owner, while still learning the ropes of the world. With patience, guidance, and plenty of positive experiences, he’s sure to blossom into the loyal, loving companion you’ve been dreaming of.

NAME: Jill
TEXT: Jill is a sweet and gentle soul who’s looking for a calm, loving home where she can settle in at her own pace. She can be a little shy to start, but with patience and kindness, she’ll begin to show you just how affectionate and loving she truly is. Jill would be best suited to a quieter lifestyle, where she can feel safe, secure, and take things one step at a time. With slow and careful introductions, she could potentially be okay around smaller dogs, especially those who are calm and respectful. If you’re looking for a soft-natured companion who will quietly steal your heart, Jill might be the perfect match.

NAME: Carly (Western Sydney)
TEXT: This is Carly! If you're looking for a sweet, gorgeous girl that will bring lots of love and fun into your home, Carly might very well be the girl for you! Carly's confident and loves to play and engage with all the humans she meets. Although she's respectful of smaller dogs during her encounters with them on lead, she would suit living in a home with another medium to large canine buddy. Carly is not just a pretty face, she's super confident and has learnt her name, so she comes when called. Come down to Western Sydney to meet Carly 🐾

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: Say hey to Shelby! This happy go lucky girl is looking for her forever home..could she be the one for you? Shelby is full of fun, loves to play with her toys and shows off her confidence when interacting with the new humans she meets. Shelby loves other dogs, showing her excitement for play and making friends when she meets other 4 legged friends. She even currently lives with a Jack Russell, so pending a meet and greet, could very well go home with a smaller (or larger) canine bestie. Come down to Western Sydney to meet Shelby! She just might be exactly what you're looking for 🐾

NAME: Maddy
TEXT: At 7 years young, Maddy is proof that age is just a number! She’s still full of life and energy, especially when it comes to her favourite pastime – zoomies! Whether it's a playful burst in the yard or a calm stroll around the block, Maddy brings a lovely balance of fun and companionship. Here’s what makes Maddy special: 🐾 Still loves a good zoomie session – full of personality and spark 🚶‍♀️ Walks beautifully on lead 🏠 Fully house trained and used to living in a family home 🐱 Hasn’t had much experience with cats or small dogs, but has shown she can be gently redirected from our meta cat Maddy would thrive in a loving home that gives her space to run and enjoy life, but also values the calmer moments too. She's the perfect mix of playful and settled – a true gem for someone looking for a mature dog with a zest for life.

NAME: Charlee
TEXT: Charlee is a beautiful girl who walks beautifully on the lead, and has even met the family cat and Jack Russell! She has experience around kids 3+ and would fit in well with a family looking to add a furry friend to their home. She is playful with the kids so kids who enjoy a fun pet would be best suited to Charlee. She loves visiting the river, travels well in cars, OK in crates, and even fine at the vets. She's a super friendly, happy girl who is also great with other greyhounds, making her a lovely fit for many homes! Charlee is used to having a backyard so a home with a townhouse/backyard would be a great fit. She is available to adopt from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Raj
TEXT: Raj is a vibrant, confident and friendly boy who would do well with a townhouse/backyard to enjoy. He does very well with other greyhounds so would happily join a multi-dog household. Raj may not be a king but he certainly has a confident personality to match his name. He has bursts of energy so would do best with children with some big dog experience. Raj has not seen much of the big wide world and would benefit from an owner who enjoys some dog training and seeing their new dog thrive under their guidance. Raj is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Eddy
TEXT: Eddy is a shy and quiet boy looking for a nurturing home to thrive in. He warms up with those he's confident with and would do best with a backyard for his zoomies when the mood strikes. Eddy hasn't seen a lot of the world yet and would thrive with a home who is looking to take it slow with him to build his confidence. Eddy can't wait to meet you and become a beloved family pet! Eddy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pete
TEXT: Looking for a dog with personality, charm, and a whole lot of love to give? Pete is your guy! This happy, playful greyhound is full of cheeky energy and is always up for fun, whether it's zoomies in the yard or curling up for cuddles. Why Pete could be your perfect match: 🐶 Playful and full of joy – never a dull moment with this guy 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Great with kids, especially older ones (he’s still working on not jumping up in excitement!) 😄 Cheeky and affectionate – he loves to initiate cuddles and gives the happiest chitters when you snuggle him 🐱 Can be redirected from chasing the resident meta cat – with some guidance, he’s learning fast 🐕 Would likely thrive with another playful dog to keep him company Pete is a big-hearted goofball who’s ready to bring fun, affection, and a few giggles to a family who will love him back. If you’re after a companion who’s equal parts playful and cuddly, Pete might just be the perfect fit.

NAME: Knocka
TEXT: Knocka is a sweet and sensitive soul looking for a calm and patient forever home where he can truly shine. This beautiful boy is still learning to come out of his shell, but with the right people, he’ll blossom into the loving companion we know he can be. Here’s what Knocka needs to thrive: 🏡 A quiet, low-traffic home to help him feel safe and secure 🐱 Cat-workable – with proper introductions and guidance 🌿 A backyard for gentle exploration and zoomies when confidence grows 🕒 A home with someone who works part-time or has a flexible schedule – he’d benefit from company while he adjusts Knocka may need a little extra time and understanding, but the reward is a loyal, gentle friend for life. If you’re patient, kind, and ready to help this special boy find his confidence, he might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Beau
TEXT: Beau is a confident, happy-go-lucky boy bursting with puppy-like energy and a love for life! Playful and engaging, he’s always up for a game or some quality time with his people—and he’s never short on tail wags. Beau would thrive in a home with another medium to large dog who can match his energy and playful nature. He’s full of enthusiasm on walks and can be strong on the lead, so a family with older kids who can keep up with his strength and spirit would be ideal. If you're after a fun-loving, social companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Beau is ready to be your new best mate!

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a happy, confident boy with a playful heart and a relaxed outlook on life. He’s the kind of dog who’s just as content having a romp around the yard as he is chilling out by your side, soaking up cuddles and pats (his favourite!). Jimmy walks with enthusiasm and might be a bit strong on the lead at times, but with a bit of practice, he’ll settle into a great walking buddy. He could potentially get along with smaller dogs too, given slow and careful introductions—he’s a sociable guy who just likes to take his time getting to know new friends. If you're after a cheerful, affectionate companion with a lovely balance of energy and calm, Jimmy could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Cooper
TEXT: Cooper is a confident, cheeky boy with a playful spark and a big personality! He’s always up for fun, whether it’s a run around the yard, a good game with a doggy mate, or heading out on an adventure. He’d thrive in an active home, especially one with another dog around his size to keep him company and match his energy. Cooper’s zest for life is infectious — he’s the kind of dog who’ll keep you laughing and moving, then happily crash for a nap once the fun’s over. If you’re looking for a playful, social, and slightly cheeky companion, Cooper could be your perfect adventure buddy!

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: Reggie is a relaxed and independent boy who’s all about the quiet life. He enjoys a bit of company and is happy to hang out with you, but he’s equally content doing his own thing — the perfect companion for someone who appreciates a low-key, easy-going dog. He does pull a little on the lead (there’s just so much to sniff!), so he’ll need a bit of guidance when it comes to walks. But with a patient and gentle hand, Reggie will soon settle into a lovely routine. If you’re looking for a calm, undemanding friend to share peaceful days with, Reggie might be your perfect match.

NAME: Jj
TEXT: JJ is a sweet, happy-go-lucky boy with the playful energy of a puppy and a heart full of love. Confident and full of charm, he’s always ready for fun — whether that’s a zoom around the garden or a goofy game with his canine pals. He’s still working on his lead manners (he’s just so excited to explore!), but with a bit of guidance, he’ll be strutting like a pro in no time. JJ might be cat-workable, but he’s definitely more in his element around other greyhounds or larger dogs. In fact, he’d thrive in a home with a doggy friend to play with and help show him the ropes. If you’re looking for a cheerful, fun-loving companion with a heart of gold, JJ is your guy!

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Angel is a confident, people-loving girl who can’t resist a good cuddle session — she’s basically a professional snuggle expert. When she’s excited, she does a happy little prance that’s guaranteed to brighten your day. She walks beautifully on lead and is always ready to be your loyal companion, whether you’re a busy family or flying solo. Now, here’s the deal: Angel isn’t a fan of small dogs or cats. Think of her as the diva of the dog world who politely requests no tiny four-legged frenemies crashing her party. So, if you don’t have any pint-sized pooches or sneaky cats, Angel is all in for a lifetime of love and fun!

NAME: Jj
TEXT: JJ is a sweet and gentle boy with a heart full of love and just the right amount of playful mischief. He’s a bit of a slow burner—once he warms up, you’ll discover his fun-loving, zoomie-ready side that’s always up for a quick burst of excitement. JJ walks nicely on lead and enjoys a good balance between lively adventures and laid-back chill time. While he’s not a big fan of cats, his charming personality more than makes up for it! If you’re after a gentle companion with a dash of goofy energy and plenty of love to give, JJ is the perfect match.

NAME: Thor
TEXT: Introducing Thor!! He is one handsome boy, with the sweetest nature, who knows how to keep things cool. This relaxed gentleman is as happy to kick back and chill as he is to join you on an adventure—he’s got the perfect balance of laid-back charm and eager enthusiasm. Thor walks like a dream on lead and absolutely adores pats and cuddles (honestly, who wouldn’t?). He’s fantastic with kids, super low maintenance, and ready to be your loyal sidekick through all of life’s ups and downs. He is more than happy to have play dates with fellow 4-legged canine friends too. Nothing makes this boy happier than being around the people he loves. If you want a handsome, easy-going companion who’s all about good vibes and great company, Thor’s your guy!

NAME: Carter
TEXT: Carter is gentle, walks on a loose leash, and would be the kind of greyhound who could live with respectful kids, or older/elderly folks, due to his laid back nature. He is lovely around other dogs around his size at the centre and would be happy to live with them. Carter would enjoy a small backyard/townhouse to call his own. He can have bursts of quirky excitement like other greyhounds but overall he is a relaxed greyhound. He is great with people in general, loves pats and will snuggle into you (to sneak in a face lick). He loves treats and attention and would do well with a family who are looking for a placid greyhound to add to the family. He is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Barba
TEXT: Barba is a beautiful boy who loves adventure. Barba would be ideal for the young professional couple or single person looking to give a dog a structured life. Barba whilst growing up in a residential street has limited house exposure. Barba is very good to take on longer walks and is a very good learner. Barba with the correct introduction would be good with medium to large dogs

NAME: Poppy
TEXT: Poppy Is a beautiful Brindle female that loves to play. Whether it be at the local oval or having a run around your backyard this girl loves to zoom. Poppy is good with older kids and is the perfect first pet for a family. Poppy settles well and walks very well on lead Poppy has grown up in a backyard where she enjoys sunning herself after a quick play. Poppy is currently undertaking some house training and is progressing very well. enquire today to find out more about Poppy

NAME: Pop Tart
TEXT: Pop Tart is a stunning lady with a heart as sweet as her name. She might be a little shy at first—think of her as a delicate flower that needs some gentle nurturing and patience to truly bloom. With the right person to give her space and time, she’ll slowly come out of her shell and reveal the delightful, goofy, and affectionate friend she’s been hiding all along. Once Pop Tart trusts you, she transforms into the ultimate cuddle buddy and loyal sidekick, ready to fill your days with warmth, laughter, and a touch of silly charm. If you’re ready to invest in a special friendship that grows beautifully at its own pace, Pop Tart can’t wait to meet you!

NAME: Neon
TEXT: 🖤 Meet Neon – The Belly Rub Queen! 🖤 Neon is a gentle 4-year-old black greyhound with a heart of gold and a love for human company. She’s the kind of dog who will quietly follow you from room to room, just happy to be near her people. Her soulful eyes and calm presence make her an instant favorite with everyone she meets. She adores belly rubs and will happily roll over to show you her soft side – literally! She’s affectionate, easygoing, and would thrive in a home where she can be part of the family and soak up all the love and attention she deserves. Whether you’re relaxing on the couch or enjoying a quiet walk, she will be right by your side, making every moment a little brighter.

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Roy is a 4-year-old greyhound who has grown up in a rural environment and is now looking for his forever home. He is a clean and well-mannered dog who never messes in his kennel, showing great potential for transitioning into a home environment with a little support for house training. He’s an excitable boy who enjoys a good run around but doesn’t jump up or show signs of destructive behaviour. Roy gets along well with other greyhounds and would thrive either as a solo dog or with a calm canine companion. Roy is well-suited to homes where the owners work full-time, as he is independent and relaxed when left alone. He would do best with a secure yard and regular opportunities to stretch his legs, ideally in a quiet, calm setting similar to his upbringing. Roy is a gentle, happy dog who just needs a little time and patience to adjust to home life. With the right guidance, he will make a loving and loyal companion.

NAME: Dixie
TEXT: Dixie is a 4-year-old brindle greyhound and the sister of Roy. She’s a smaller girl with a big personality, full of charm and playful energy. Dixie is a good kennel dog who keeps her space clean and enjoys a structured routine. She’s an excited little lady who absolutely loves to show off her zoomies in the yard. Despite her bursts of energy, she settles down quickly and is happy to relax once she’s had a chance to stretch her legs. Dixie would suit a family environment and is good with children aged 5 and up. She’s gentle, affectionate, and thrives on attention. With her easy-going nature and love of fun, Dixie would make a delightful addition to a home that can offer her both playtime and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Buddy
TEXT: Meet Buddy! A happy, friendly dog who loves meeting people, is easy going and loves life. Basking in the sun is one of his favourites past-times, as is playing in the yard with his greymates and attention from his humans. He loves it when he comes inside and lies on the rug but would love a couch all to himself (currently occupied by the 'boss' girls). He's also happy spending time on his own during the day, hanging out in the garden, sun-snoozing on the grass or in a sheltered spot in cooler times (veranda, gazebo). Buddy is an easy maintenance lad who just wants some love and attention and a cruisy, simple life. He will making a loving companion for anyone wanting an affectionate friend to hang out with. 💙

NAME: Kirby
TEXT: Oh hey there! My name's Kirby and I would love to tell you all about how I would be your perfect pet! I've had some experience living as a pet and I was an excellent house guest however we discovered I really love my food. The amazing trainers here at GAP have been working on my sharing, so my new home can continue this training with their help. Fun games like "leave it" (which I'm getting really good at by the way!) are doing wonders in my progress! Running around and playing in the sun is the best thing ever, and I would love my new fur-ever home to have a backyard to call my own. With my love for sunbaking and zoomies I am more than happy being a predominantly outside dog with supervised or restricted access to the house. Full-time workers are a-ok with me, though I am still a big snuggle bug who will shower you with love and affection when you get home. I love exploring new places and my friends at GAP say I walk very well on lead, so if you're looking for a walking partner for your quiet morning/evening stroll I'm your guy. Not to brag, but I really am a true genius, mastering many cues including "down", "stay", "shake", "touch", "crate", "leave it", "heel", and—drumroll, please—the legendary greyhound sit! I find daily training sessions and enrichment activities super fun and a great way to keep my super smart brain occupied and stimulated. I can't wait to meet my forever family! So come on down to GAP Western Sydney to meet (and fall in love with) me!

NAME: Harry
TEXT: Harry is a total catch! He is friendly, confident, good with humans and dogs, and a happy bubbly boy. He likes to play, has a good food drive, showing to be very trainable, he also walks lovely on the leash. He is confident on lead and in new environments as well as super polite with our greyhounds and small dogs here at the centre. Harry is a gentle, yet playful, lovely mix of all the perfect greyhound quirks! If he's not smooching up to you, he's sniffing out the treats in your pocket or finding a toy to entertain himself with. This goofy love bug is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Henry
TEXT: Henry has lived his life surrounded by children, and would suit a home with a family of children who are eager to give him lots of love. Henry is a social butterfly who loves a bit of attention! He would suit a home with another medium to large dog who is on the chill side like him. His previous owners have summed him up as a big goof ball, who is placid, even a little bit clumsy! He settles well on his bed and is happy to watch the world go by with you by his side. Henry is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Meri
TEXT: Little 23kg Meri has been around children 1+ to 14 years old, she loves a bit of attention and loves to run off with toys and have a bit of fun. She is a friendly, confident, yet relaxed girl. Meri would enjoy a backyard/townhouse with or without a greyhound pal to spend her days with, she would also be suitable around children due to her history of exposure with kids! Meri is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Popeye
TEXT: Popeye is a handsome, goofy boy who's bursting with personality. He lives for playtime, whether it's a good game of fetch, tug with his favourite rope toy, or zoomies in the yard. He's social and enjoys the company of other medium to large dogs, especially those who can keep up with his playful energy. Popeye would thrive in an active household or with someone who has a secure backyard where he can stretch those long legs and get his daily dose of fun. He's also happy just hanging out once he's had his play, he knows how to chill when the time is right. When it comes to walks, Popeye has been doing really well with his training. He's learning to stay focused and calm, especially when small dogs are around. He does best when you bring his favourite toy along, it helps redirect his attention and keeps him happily engaged with you. Ongoing positive training and consistent management have helped him progress beautifully. With the right guidance, Popeye's a total gem. He's smart, responsive, and full of love to give. In return, you'll gain a loyal sidekick who's always ready for fun and fiercely devoted to his people.

NAME: Ox
TEXT: Ox is the big softie that makes your heart melt. Ox is currently living inside a home learning to love the relaxed life. Ox still enjoys his walk and is a delight to walk on lead. This big guy is a kind hearted boy who loves sleeping the day away. Ox enjoys human company but is also happy to be left alone for full time working hours. Ox enjoys a car ride and lazing on his bed in your home

NAME: Max
TEXT: if you are looking for a boy who is very laid back and affectionate at the same time then you must meet Max Max is a beautiful and soft black boy who is looking for his perfect backyard Max enjoys a daily walk and has grown up around small children. Max enjoys lazing the day away in the sun and is a very care free boy. Max was raised around small sausage dogs and has lived with other greyhounds. Max is the final piece to a families perfect puzzle

NAME: Carly
TEXT: Carly may take a little time to fully warm up but once she does, you'll find a wonderfully affectionate pup. Patience will reveal Carly's true nature: a loyal and cuddly grey. Carly can be apprehensive and may shy away when approached from above, but if you crouch down to her level, you'll soon discover her gentle heart and spark of curiosity. Her ideal home would be a calm environment where she can enjoy plenty of affection and cozy snuggles without feeling rushed or overwhelmed. A home with a part-time worker would be an excellent fit for Carly, as she'd benefit from having company during the day. With time, patience, and love, Carly will become an irreplaceable member of your household, full of love and ready to receive it in return.

NAME: Alf
TEXT: Alf is a handsome young male. He is destined for pet life as he is a relaxed, playful, affectionate confident boy. He loves diving into the water when he can - a true water baby! He enjoys lounging around the yard, basking in the sun and creating life long memories playing with little humans. Alf would be suited to a household with full time workers with a backyard or a family with younger children.

NAME: Diesel (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Diesel 🐾 I'm a gorgeous confident boy, ready to bring some fun to the life of my new family. I adore all humans and even grew up around children myself, making me the perfect addition to your family! I would love my new home all to myself as I thrive when I'm the only star of the show⭐ Oh and I also love to play and chase after my toys so a backyard would be great for me! If you think I could be the guy for you, come and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Kane
TEXT: Kane is a social and confident lad with a charming personality. Kane is a good traveller, enjoys spending time with other hounds and has been described as playful, fun, and very lazy! He is a wonderful blend of calm, with that perky playful side! Kane would enjoy a townhouse/backyard, and a home with or without respectful children. A family with another M-L canine companion would also be well suited to this sweet gentleman. Kane is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cuddles
TEXT: Hi, I'm Cuddles! Not only do I know how to cuddle, I also know how to "sit" which is apparently a big deal for greyhounds - who knew?! I can also do staircases! I've been socialised around a few types of dogs, so I'm ready to join a multi-dog household or one who would like their dog to head down to the cafe and catch up with the local dogs. I have been around a mini foxy X chihuahua and a kelpie, and of course greyhounds too, whom I love. PS...I can also be rehomed with my sister, Siri and Lulu. Enquire with the Western Sydney team to meet me.

NAME: Reba
TEXT: *Reba is in a foster care home - enquire with the team for more info* Reba is our 7-year-old girl with a soft heart and an even softer spot for cuddles. She’s incredibly affectionate, calm, and friendly. The kind of dog who wants nothing more than to be by your side, whether that’s curling up on the couch or quietly following you through the house. Her gentle nature makes her a great fit for families, including those with children. Reba is also wonderfully independent. She’s perfectly suited to full-time workers, as she’s happy to relax during the day and will greet you with the warmest welcome when you return. She gets along well with other medium to large dogs and could happily share her home with a canine companion of similar size. Reba would love a home with a secure backyard where she can enjoy her own little adventures, zoomies, sunbathing, and taking in the breeze. She doesn’t need daily walks, and in fact, would be happiest in a home where walks are optional. She’s a great pet for a low-key lifestyle with plenty of love, a routine, and the freedom to just be herself. Reba is ready to be someone’s heart dog, a loyal, loving companion who asks for very little but gives so much in return.

NAME: Meraki
TEXT: Hi, I'm Meraki, I'm a super sweet girl, who cant wait to find my new home! I can be a little shy at first, but with a bit of time and a chance to warm up to you, I'll be ready to give and take lots of love 💖 I wouldn't mind sharing my new home with another canine buddy, big or small! In fact, I think a new friend is exactly what I'll need in my new home. I can also walk up and down stair cases! PS...I can also be rehomed with my sister, Cuddles! I can't wait to meet you at Western Sydney!

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: This is Lulu 🐾 This confident girl is full of life and is ready to bring lots of love and fun into your home! Lulu shows lots of training potential as a few treats are the way to this girls heart. Lulu loves to give affection just as much as she loves to give it and cant wait to find her new family. Her new family might even already have a another dog, which Lulu wouldn't mind! Are you ready for lovely Lulu to become apart of your family? Meet her at Western Sydney 😄

NAME: Siri
TEXT: Say Hey Siri, to Siri 👋 This gorgeous girl knows it all and is ready to teach you a thing or two about bringing fun to your life! Any questions you have, Siri has the answer for! What to do on a beautiful sunny day? Throw her toys around in the backyard of course! What about when the weather isn't so great? Movies in bed ALL day she reckons! Do greyhounds get along with other dogs? She sure does! How do I win my new greyhound over? Treats, treats and more treats is always her answer! Is Siri everything you've been looking for? Her answer is YES! Come down and meet her at Western Sydney 🐾

NAME: Evie
TEXT: Hi, I'm Evie! I'm a sweet, gentle girl looking for a place to call home! I love my walks and have shown to be quite well mannered whilst I'm out and about. I may be a little shy at first but once I warm up to you, I love lots of pats and ear scratches. I love my greyhound buddies, and pending a meet and greet, I wouldn't mind going home with canine companion! I cant wait to meet my new family 🏠 If you think I might be the girl for you, come meet me at Western Sydney 🐾

NAME: Sandy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Sandy is in a foster home with 2 greyhounds - check in for more updates soon!* Weighing in at just 24 kg this teeny tiny girl makes up for her size with her adorable personality! Sweet, happy, confident little girl Sandy requires a home with human, or preferably canine companionship. She is a social butterfly who thrives around other dogs so we would love to see her forever home be much like her foster home, where she has dog companionship. She is a confident lady who walks super nicely on the lead. She likes treats and will definitely persuade you with her puppy dog eyes. She has spent time living with other greyhounds in foster and before her GAP days, and would be a fabulous fit for a multi-dog household. Playful and loving, she absolutely loves people and has never met someone she didn't like - making her suitable for a busy social life or a family with active kids. She is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cobalt
TEXT: **Cobalt is currently in a foster home, reach out to the team for info! He has even been friendly with free ranging pet chickens!** Cobalt foster update: He would prefer to have access to inside and outside the house during the day especially when you are not home. He sleeps right throughout the night and snoozes most of the day. He loves going for walks and knows how to communicate it to you by getting your attention and pointing his nose to his leash. His doing well with our chickens provided that they are behind the fence. When we do let the chickens out he is well behaved on his leash. He is a very gentle sweet boy that loves hugs, pats and praises. He is not highly motivated with food more on praises and pats. He loves playing with his squeeky toy and loves playing fetch. He is still yet to learn how to give the ball back though. Cobalt is a super affectionate and cuddly companion who can't wait to begin spending time with his new family and can be suited to a household with full time workers. This cheerful boy has shown to be very polite with other medium/large breed dogs and is open to sharing his new home with another dog friend. A backyard would be amazing so he can have somewhere to run around and play! Whether he's playing in the backyard or just enjoying a lazy afternoon, Cobalt brings joy wherever he goes!

NAME: Emi
TEXT: Emi is a very sweet little lady who shines once she feels comfortable. She loves jumping up for snuggles and cuddles, and enjoys chasing toys during playtime. Emi has grown up around children and would do well with the company of medium to large dogs. Gentle, playful, and full of heart, she’s ready to find a loving home to call her own.

NAME: Prince
TEXT: Prince is a very handsome boy with a playful heart and a love for life! He’s affectionate, engaging, and always up for a game of chase with his favorite toys. Prince gets along well with smaller dogs and would be thrilled to have a yard where he can run and play to his heart’s content.

NAME: Dolly
TEXT: Dolly is a charming girl, she likes meeting new people. She is very cuddly and affectionate. She comes when called and plays with toys. She is a good mixture of a hound that wants to go for a walk and be social with also wanting to lounge around doing nothing.

NAME: Matey
TEXT: *I'm currently in a foster home* Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and happy go lucky energy, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! Matey is in a foster care home and we have learnt he loves spending time with his family and going for a quiet sniffari around the block! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey is an enthusiastic, gentle, smart and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a laid back yet playful friend. Matey suits part-time or full-time workers, and would enjoy a small yard to call his own. Get ready to meet your new best Matey! This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Oakley
TEXT: Oakley is an energetic and fun loving greyhound, he thrives when given structured activities. His ideal owner will love all of his drive, energy and passion for all things fun. His best fit would be an owner who is eager to actively train and work with him. He is a driven hound driven who loves physical and mental stimulation. His perfect match will be someone looking for a highly trainable and driven dog who enjoys training as much as he does. He has a strong need for physical and mental stimulation. His recall is excellent, he performs 'down' on cue, and he has the ability to walk nicely in heel position after exercise. He loves the outdoors and would do best as an outside dog. He is available now from our Western Sydney centre.

NAME: Sully
TEXT: Hi, I'm Sully, a gentle, quiet natured blue boy looking for my new home. I get along great with other dogs and don’t mind spending time in the yard while you’re out – but I do love having the freedom to go in and out as I please. I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and take in the fresh air throughout the day. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river (see photos)! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. When I first started going on walks, I wasn’t sure what to do, but with some patience and encouragement, I’ve learned to keep going and haven’t had any issues in a long time! Now, I just take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I have even learnt to walk up and down stairs! I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in, but I thrive best in a home where I still get plenty of interaction throughout the day. I love being around my people and enjoy a good balance of companionship and independence. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Lemon
TEXT: Whether it's her adorable overbite smile, or cheeky playful nature, Lemon is a sweet and gentle soul with a heart full of love to give. She is super affectionate and adorable and suits indoor unit/apartment living or a backyard. Read on to see what she's learnt during her time at GAP, proving you can teach an older dog new tricks! Lemon has conquered the following exciting milestones: - Walking up and down stairs - Hanging out with other greyhounds - Learning to toilet on cue - The 'touch' cue Lemon would suit a home with respectful children and a house with a backyard or unit/apartment, and would enjoy living with another likeminded greyhound too! Lemon doesn’t ask for much—just a short daily walk and some love and TLC. If Lemon sounds like she will bring the zest into your life, enquire to meet her today!

NAME: Phantom
TEXT: *Phantom is in a foster care home with cats* Meet Phantom! He is suitable in a house or unit, and with or without dogs/cats in the home. Hours alone are fine by him as he entertains himself by snoozing the day away. A lover of the indoors, and a conqueror of the stairs, he is fine for apartment life, too. He's a friend to canines and felines and would happily share his space, unphased by other four legged friends. Phantom loves to lean in for pats and ear scratches, and is ready to soak up the love from his new family just as much as he's ready to give it! Come down and meet Phantom at Western Sydney!

NAME: Peanut
TEXT: Peanut is a super sweet and cuddly girl 🐶 who’s full of love and ready to share it. She’s looking for a supportive home where she can continue to grow, learn, and feel safe. Peanut would do especially well with a canine companion to keep her company, as she doesn’t like being left alone. She gets along wonderfully with smaller dog breeds and is gentle and loving with children ❤️

NAME: Hawke
TEXT: Hawke is a playful and happy boy 🐶, full of energy and confidence. He loves toys, gets excited easily, and brings joy wherever he goes! With a safe and slow introduction, Hawke has the potential to become best friends with your smaller dogs and even cats. He’s also great around young children, making him a fun and loving addition to a lively family. ❤️

NAME: Amber
TEXT: Amber is a gentle soul who may be a little shy at first 🐶, but with a warm and comforting home, she begins to shine. She blossoms with patience, support, and love ❤️, and would thrive best in a calm, peaceful environment. Older, understanding children would be a great match for her, helping her feel safe and supported as she builds confidence and truly comes into her own.

NAME: Jed
TEXT: Jed is a very handsome boy 🐶 with a playful spirit and a heart full of charm. He’s interactive and social, always ready to make new friends and spread good vibes. Confident yet a little goofy, Jed is easygoing and happy-go-lucky — the kind of companion who makes every moment more fun and lighthearted. ❤️

NAME: Queenie
TEXT: Queenie is a confident and loving soul 💖, radiating warmth wherever she goes. Her friendly, outgoing nature 🐾 makes her a joy to be around, and she thrives in social settings. Playful and engaging, Queenie brings happiness to every room she enters, leaving a lasting impression with her vibrant personality and boundless affection 🥰.

NAME: Gem
TEXT: Young blue girl Gem is a gentle soul with a world of love to give – she’s just looking for the right person to help her shine. Gem loves children! This beautiful girl may be a little shy at first, but with time, patience, and a calm environment, she blossoms into a loyal and affectionate companion. Gem is the kind of dog who forms deep bonds with her people and rewards kindness with quiet devotion. She feels most at ease in the company of other greyhounds and would likely thrive in a home with a calm canine friend to show her the ropes. Gem is seeking a peaceful household without children, where she can settle into a predictable routine and feel safe. With the right support, Gem has so much potential – all she needs is a gentle heart and a soft place to land. If you are interested, please reach out the Western Sydney team.

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: Ryan has spent time in a foster home - keep reading to find out why his foster dad loves him! "Ryan is a sweet, gentle soul with the calmest nature you’ll ever meet. He loves lounging near you quietly, always happy to just be in your presence. He walks beautifully on the lead, gets along well with people, and has such expressive eyes that tell you exactly how he’s feeling. He’s low-maintenance, clean, and well-behaved around the house. He enjoys short walks and long naps, and has a soft spot for comfy bedding and gentle pats. While I’ve come to care for him deeply, I’ve realised I’m not quite ready for a dog at this stage. Ryan deserves a home where he can be someone’s forever companion. He’ll make an incredible addition to any calm, loving household." Ryan would suit a full-time working family, with a backyard. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would also suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan has conquered the Richmond main drag (pictured!). Did we mention he's super smart, too? He knows 'on your bed', down & shake among many other – he loves training so an owner who likes to engage in training would be a perfect match! Ryan is waiting here for you at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Axel
TEXT: Axel is a sweet and sensitive greyhound who’s looking for a home where he can continue to build his confidence and thrive with a little guidance. While he’s not overly timid, he does best in a home that offers clear structure, routine, and patient support as he navigates the world. Axel is affectionate and eager to please, and once he settles in, he becomes a calm and loyal companion. He enjoys the company of other greyhounds and could do well with a confident dog buddy to help him feel at ease. Axel is best suited to a quieter household without young kids, where he can relax and grow at his own pace. With a supportive environment and consistent routine, Axel has all the right ingredients to become a happy, well-adjusted family member.

NAME: Romeo
TEXT: Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo? Why I’m right here at Western Sydney! If you’ve been searching for your soul mate then look no further than gorgeous Romeo. Romeo is a gentle soul who loves love! Romeo has a goofy and charming personality! A gentleman by nature, he’s as graceful as he is affectionate. Whether it’s cuddling up for a quiet evening or running through the fields, Romeo is ready to share his world with you. We can guarantee this love story won’t end in tragedy...come down for a chance at love at first sight (hound)!

NAME: Pixel
TEXT: *Pixel is in a foster care home - reach out to the team for info!* If you're looking for a fun-loving greyhound who brings excitement and affection in equal measure, 1 year old little Miss Pixel could be the perfect fit for your family. Pixel is living in a foster care home where she is excelling with toilet training and learning how to become the best pet! Pixel is a bright and bubbly young greyhound who’s full of personality and always ready for fun! With her puppy-like energy and love for play, she’s the perfect match for an active family with kids. She has spent time with a staffy and gets along beautifully with other dogs, showing a mix of playful and respectful behaviours. Pixel would do well in a home that embraces her energy and provides structure, enrichment, and plenty of love. She is loved by her foster carer but we can't wait to see her in her forever home! Pixel is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Goose
TEXT: Goose is, well, just a big goose! Only 32 kg, gentle and loves attention. He likes to wander around the sheds with his owner and visits the farm border collie who he loves to play with. He's a good traveller, no house experience, but was walked in town as a puppy. He's used to pottering about, but dreams of finding that comfy couch or spot in the garden, patio or verandah. He's friendly and happy to meet new people with a wag of his tail, loves a swim in the dam and loves his toys. He has been around kids 10+, and when you're not around to follow about, he is happy to amuse himself throwing his toys up in the air, especially his beloved soccer ball. Goose is a gentle, happy-go-lucky boy who would make a wonderful, loyal and easy going companion. Goose doesn't bark, except occasionally as a reminder for a bit of attention if you've stopped patting or when its dinner time! He lost 2 toes on his back left foot due to an injury as a puppy, which doesn't bother him, otherwise a healthy lad who has so much love to give. 💙

NAME: Dylan
TEXT: Meet Dylan—a true pocket rocket bursting with energy and enthusiasm for life! This fun-loving boy is always on the go, whether it’s heading out for a walk, sprinting around the yard in full zoomie mode, or playing endlessly with his favourite toys. Dylan thrives in a home that can match his pace and give him the physical and mental stimulation he craves. He’ll need an active household with a good-sized yard and experienced children who are confident around large, energetic dogs. While Dylan doesn’t show strong prey drive, he can be a bit too much for small breeds, so he’s best suited to homes with a robust, playful canine companion of similar size—pending a successful meet and greet. He’s a whirlwind of joy, curiosity, and excitement, and would make a wonderful addition to a family that embraces his zest for life and is ready for all the fun he brings

NAME: Pocket
TEXT: *Pocket is living in a unit/apartment foster care home* Foster Notes: "She is really lovely, very affectionate and loves meeting new people. She hasn’t shown any signs of resource guarding or sleep startle, and she is very happy to snooze most of the day away." Pocket is a bouncy, fun little thing! She is very playful, hilarious and goofy, and will definitely make you laugh with her antics! Known for her cuddles, we love her here at the centre as she will snuggle right into you for a cuddle when you crouch down. She is very outgoing and affectionate, and we know someone will just love her for her silly cute personality. Due to her wiggly, bouncy nature we'd recommend older children in the home. This adorable, affectionate girl is known for her love of toys and fun loving personality. Pocket is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Shadow
TEXT: Lurking in the shadows is this beautiful boy! Shadow is learning 'pet prep' in his current home, which includes spending time indoors, spending time with children, and small dogs! Having been around kids 10 years old and over, as well as 3 small dogs - Jack Russel, Pomeranian and Dachshund, he has perfected the art of the top 2 greyhound past times - playing and sleeping together. Shadow would be a wonderful addition to a family with dogs, children, and a townhouse/backyard for Shadow to enjoy spending time in. Shadow would enjoy being a member of the family and being included on walks, adventures, and cuddling watching TV at night. Shadow is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Naomi
TEXT: Naomi is a sweet & shy girl. She is suitable to live with other dogs including small dogs! Although initially shy, she is a brave girl who warms up well with consistent, gentle handling. Naomi would enjoy a quiet home with a grassy courtyard/backyard. She likes to keep to herself but travels well and is working on her confidence every day. If you're looking for a sweet and gentle hound who you can watch thrive with your nurturing personality, consider adopting Naomi. Naomi is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Chief
TEXT: Meet Chief – a handsome, easy-going boy with a heart of gold. This laid-back fella is happy entertaining himself or just chillin' solo 😎. Patient and gentle, Chief is great with small children and gets along well with other animals. He grew up around a cattle dog and has been exposed to goats, so farm life is nothing new to him. Whether he's playing or relaxing in the sun, Chief brings a calm, loyal energy to any home 🐾.

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Pepper has a kind and gentle nature that instantly wins over everyone she meets. She’s easygoing, affectionate, and loves being part of the action, whether it’s with her human family or her fellow dog friends. Pepper’s playful yet calm demeanor makes her a joy to be around, and she’s ready to share her love with the lucky family who takes her home!

NAME: Alvie
TEXT: Alvie is a delightful and sweet greyhound. He’s a shy boy who needs a loyal and loving friend to do life with. Once he has settled in, Alvies's personality shines through in everything he does, making him a delightful and loyal friend who is always ready to share his love. Alvies perfect home would be an experienced doggy handler who has the time to win his trust and help him to adjust to a new life 💕

NAME: Pete
TEXT: For Pete's sake, look at this handsome boy! Pete is a shy and reseved boy looking for a calm, low stimulus home to enjoy his retirement. Pete would do best without children and would love a backyard to retreat to when things get too busy for him. Pete is a delight around other greyhounds and gains confidence around them. A nurturing and relaxed owner would suit him the best. We think he would love to either live with another greyhound and/or continue socialisation around other dogs. Pete is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a sweet, goofy boy. He loves throwing toys around, is known to be ultra-affectionate, and will turn into a wiggly worm when he's excited! Did we mention he's sooo cute, too? The super friendly and polite dog who brings a smile to everyone he meets! Tom has a special knack for making friends wherever he goes with his gentle nature and waggy tail. He adores humans and is always ready to lend a listening ear or a comforting paw. Tom can conquer stairs, and enjoys a small outdoor area to stretch his legs. Whether you're going for a walk or just hanging out at home, Tom will be your loyal companion and best friend, spreading joy and kindness with every wag. Tom enjoys a slow exposure to busy areas however we know he can build confidence! Tom gets along great with other medium to large dogs and could potentially make a small dog friend, pending a meet and greet. Get ready to fall in love with this delightful pup! Available at Western Sydney 😄

NAME: Lloyd
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Lloyd! 💙 Lloyd may be a little shy when meeting new people, but with a supportive and understanding family, he quickly blossoms into a confident, happy, and loving boy. 🐶 Smart and full of potential, Lloyd is just waiting for the right people to help him shine. If you're looking for a sweet companion who’ll grow into your best buddy, Lloyd is ready to meet you! 💫

NAME: Flow
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Flow! 🌸 Flow is a very sweet girl with a heart full of potential. 💕 She's ready to learn, grow, and succeed with the help of a loving, supportive home. With a little training and plenty of encouragement, she’ll blossom into an amazing companion. She’d do best with older, understanding children and could be a great match for a calm, medium-large dog friend. If you're looking for a kind soul to grow with, Flow is ready to start her journey with you! 🐶💫

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jasper! 💙 Jasper is an affectionate, sweet, and kind-hearted boy who just wants to be loved. 🐶 He’s playful and gentle, with so much potential to shine in the right home. He’s still learning and will need a supportive family to continue his training and help build his confidence. Jasper would do best with older, understanding children and could get along well with a compatible medium-large dog. If you're ready to open your heart to a truly lovable companion, Jasper is waiting for you! 💕

NAME: Reggie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Reggie! 🐶 Reggie is an active, playful, and seriously handsome boy! 😍 He's full of energy and would love a yard where he can run, play, and burn off that puppy spirit. Still working on his manners, Reggie needs a patient, understanding family ready to guide him with love and consistency. He’d do best with older kids and could be a great match for a friendly medium-large dog buddy. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion to grow with, Reggie’s your guy! 💙

NAME: Emma
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Emma! 💖 Emma is a gentle soul with so much love to give. She may be a little shy at first, but with patience and kindness, her sweet personality shines through. 💕 She’s looking for a calm, supportive family to help her grow in confidence with continued training and socialisation. Emma enjoys the company of well-mannered dogs (especially larger ones!) and would do best with older, understanding children. A secure yard to play and explore would be the cherry on top for this lovely girl. 🐶🌿

NAME: Jodie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Jodie! 💕 Jodie is a sweet, goofy girl with a big heart and an even bigger personality! 💖 She’s bursting with playful energy and would love a yard where she can zoom around and enjoy all her favorite games. Jodie is still learning the ropes, so she’ll need a patient, loving home committed to helping her grow with consistent training and gentle guidance. 🐶 She’d thrive with older, understanding kids and could do well with a medium-large dog friend who matches her vibe. If you’re ready to laugh, play, and love a little extra every day—Jodie’s your girl! 💕

NAME: Benson
TEXT: Meet Benson – A Gentle Giant with a Heart Full of Love 💙🐾 Benson is a sweet, kind-hearted boy who’s still finding his way in the world. This gentle giant is looking for a calm, supportive home where he can grow in confidence, surrounded by patience, understanding, and lots of love. He’ll need ongoing training and encouragement, but with the right guidance, Benson will blossom into the most loyal companion. He’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are calm and respectful, and would do best with older, understanding children who can give him the space and gentleness he needs. If you have a little extra room in your home—and your heart—Benson might just be the perfect fit. 💛

NAME: Ducky
TEXT: Meet Ducky – A Sweet, Gentle Soul Ready for Her Cozy Forever Home 🐾💗 Ducky is a loving, affectionate older girl who’s all about the cuddles and calm vibes. She’s looking for a slower-paced home where she can enjoy the quiet life with people who appreciate the beauty of a relaxed routine. Ducky would love a family with older, understanding children, and she’s suitable to live with medium to large dogs who are respectful and calm like her. If you're after a sweet companion who just wants to be loved and lounge by your side, Ducky might be your perfect match 🐾💗

NAME: Goofy
TEXT: Meet Goofy – A Special Boy Looking for His Special Home 🐶💛 Goofy is a sweet male with a quirky charm and a heart ready to bond. He’s looking for a quiet, patient home where he can take things at his own pace. Goofy needs someone who understands that dogs like him need time, gentle guidance, and a whole lot of love to build trust. He’s still learning about the world, so training and socialization will be key to helping him grow into his best self. Goofy would do best as the only dog in the home, with older, understanding children who can respect his boundaries. With the right people, Goofy will shine – could that be you?

NAME: Sofia
TEXT: Meet Sofia – A Loving Blue Beauty Looking for Her Forever Home 💙🐾 Sofia is a beautiful blue female with a gentle soul and a heart full of potential. She's looking for a home that can offer her support, understanding, and time—someone patient and committed to helping her grow with continued training and care. Sofia has an old injury to her front leg, so she’ll need a family that understands her physical needs and can help her feel safe and comfortable. She thrives best as a single dog in the household and would be happiest with older, dog-savvy children who can respect her space and needs. If you’re ready to offer a calm, loving home where Sofia can continue her journey, she’s ready to meet you. 💙

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal! The King of Cuddles and Playtime! 🐾 If you're looking for a loyal companion who’s both noble and a bit goofy, Royal is ready to bring you love, fun and lots of personality. This charming greyhound enjoys his toys and loves to play! Royal walks beautifully on lead and adores his daily walks. He's polite around smaller dogs but would prefer to share his kingdom with a medium or large canine companion. Ready to give Royal his happily ever after? Come and meet this beautiful boy at Western Sydney...he’s been waiting for his crowning moment! 👑

NAME: Hank (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hank has spent some time in a foster care home, living within a retirement village with his foster carer. He is wonderfully laid back and gentle. He is a dream to walk on the lead and would enjoy a similarly calm forever home. His foster carer has described him as 'beautiful', 'divine', and has noted that he is great with kids and other people he's met out on strolls around the complex. He's especially taken to the grandkids who are 12+ years old. He loves to play and collect items. He's so friendly and everyone loves him. The foster carer notes he doesn't need a lot of space (as they have a small villa yard), loves his walks, is great with the mobility walker, and is a lovely, friendly, playful and perfect first foster greyhound for their living situation. Hank has a goofy playful side and loves to toss his toys around. He doesn't mind spending time entertaining himself or napping in a quiet backyard while you're out at work. If you are retired, living a laid back life, use a walker, or just looking for a calm companion, do not hesitate to reach out to the adoption team to discuss adopting Hank. Hank is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Felix
TEXT: Felix is a chilled-out charmer who’s just happy to be part of the fun. He’s quiet, calm, and has a super relaxed nature—nothing really bothers him! Whether it's hanging out with other dogs or being around kids, Felix fits right in. He’s friendly, gentle, and goes with the flow. This sweet boy doesn’t have a care in the world—he’s just looking for a comfy spot, some love, and maybe a snack or two. Felix is the kind of dog who brings a little bit of sunshine into every day without ever asking for much in return. If you’re after a gentle, low-fuss companion who gets along with everyone, Felix might just be your perfect match. 🐾💙

NAME: Tylah
TEXT: Tylah is a beautiful, gentle soul who’s mastered the art of relaxing. She’s a laid-back lady who loves her naps and cozy spots, but don’t let that fool you—she still has her zoomie moments! Short bursts of energy are her specialty, followed by lots of lounging and cuddles. She’s happiest when she’s with her people, always close by and ready to share her calm, loving presence. Loyal, sweet, and full of quiet charm, Tylah is the kind of companion who makes every day feel a little more peaceful. If you're looking for a loyal, low-maintenance best friend who will love being by your side (especially on the couch), Tylah might just be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Digger
