TEXT: Digger is a curious, affectionate boy who loves to learn and be involved in whatever you're doing. He’s attentive, enjoys playing with his toys, and thrives on interaction. Digger would do best as the only dog in the home and would love having older children to play and bond with.

NAME: Brad
TEXT: Brad is a lively, energetic boy once he feels at home. He enjoys playtime, especially in a backyard where he can stretch his legs and have fun. Brad is good with smaller dogs and would do well in a home with older children. A sweet, active companion ready for his next adventure!

NAME: Rafiki
TEXT: Rafiki is a lively, energetic boy with an incredible love for toys! He’s a one-dog fetch machine—happily tossing his own toys just to chase them down again. Social, interactive, and full of fun, Rafiki brings playful energy and joy wherever he goes.

NAME: Dempsey
TEXT: Dempsey is a fun-loving, affectionate boy with a big personality and an even bigger love for his toys. He's interactive, silly, and always ready to make you laugh with his goofy antics. Dempsey does well with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction. A joyful companion who’s all about play, cuddles, and good vibes!

NAME: Zazu
TEXT: Zazu is a gentle male who takes a little time to settle in, but once he's comfortable, his playful and funny personality shines through. He absolutely loves his toys and enjoys exploring his surroundings with curiosity. Zazu gets along well with smaller dogs and cats after a slow, safe introduction. A sweet soul with a goofy side, he’s sure to bring joy and laughter to a patient and loving home.

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Daisy is a lovely hound, she is very social, confident and friendly. She is great around everybody and will make an excellent addition to your life. She is good on the lead and great company. She is also happy to live with full-time workers.

NAME: Garry
TEXT: Garry is a true companion and ready to become anyone’s best friend. Garry is 4 years of age and has grown up in a residential home whilst also living with other greyhounds. Garry enjoys his daily walk around town and makes friends with the neighbourhood children and dogs on his walk. With the correct introduction Garry could he suited to younger children and would be amazing in a townhouse or apartment with a walk everyday.

NAME: Rockstar
TEXT: Rockstar is the coolest, most laid-back guy around! Just like his name, he’s a chilled-out rockstar who loves attention and enjoys hanging out with people—especially kids. He’s great with all dogs and loves to play, making him the perfect companion for a fun-loving household. Rockstar is as friendly as they come and always ready to be part of the action. If you’re looking for a relaxed, happy, and playful buddy who’s always ready for some fun, Rockstar is your guy!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet Bruce! 🖤 Bruce is a sweet, laid-back boy with a charming personality. He gets along well with small dogs and is always happy to spend time with his human friends. Bruce does have pannus, a condition that affects his eyes. While it's not curable, it’s easily managed with treatment to keep him comfortable. If you’re looking for a friendly, easy-going companion with a big heart, Bruce is ready to bring his charm into your life!

NAME: Sonny
TEXT: Sonny is a strong, happy, and fun-loving boy who adores people and loves to play! He’s always up for some fun with his favorite toys—he absolutely loves them and could play all day. Sonny gets along great with medium to large breed dogs and would be happiest with a female dog friend. He’d also love to have a yard where he can run and play to his heart’s content. If you’re looking for an energetic and toy-obsessed companion with a heart full of love, Sonny might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Venus
TEXT: Venus is a beautiful, independent lady who is an absolute delight to have around. She’s perfectly happy relaxing on her own but still enjoys some attention and pats when you're nearby. She’s been socialised with small dogs and, while she’s not overly interested in them, she’s calm and well-behaved in their company. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance companion who enjoys both quiet time and a little love, Venus could be the one for you! She may be nearly 8 years old but she still has lots of love to share.

NAME: Matty
TEXT: Matty is a relaxed and happy boy who loves nothing more than a pat and a tasty treat! He’s very friendly and has been socialised with small dogs, making him a lovely companion for a variety of homes. With his calm nature and sweet personality, Matty is the kind of dog who just wants to hang out, enjoy your company, and maybe sneak an extra snack or two! If you’re looking for an easy-going buddy with a big heart, Matty’s your guy.

NAME: Cia
TEXT: Meet Cia! 💙 Cia may be nearly 8, but she’s young at heart and full of love! She’s a happy, friendly girl who enjoys the simple things in life—like a short walk, a comfy bed, and a ride in the car (one of her favourite things!). Cia is social with other dogs and gets along best with large breeds or calm small dogs. She’s easy-going and loves being part of the action, but also knows how to relax and take it easy. Cia thinks an apartment would be fine as long as she does not have to walk up and down stairs. If you’re after a sweet and gentle companion who still has a spring in her step, Cia could be the perfect match!

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a handsome, happy, and playful boy who’s full of personality! He loves life and enjoys being around people and other dogs—especially other greyhounds. Bob is strong and can get a little overexcited around small dogs, so he’d do best in a home without them. He would love to live with a medium to large female dog, or he’d be just as happy as the only dog in the home. If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion with a big heart and a beautiful brindle coat, Bob could be your perfect match!

NAME: Wolfie
TEXT: Wolfie is the sweetest older gentleman you will ever meet! At 8 years old, he still has plenty of life and love to give. With his soft demeanor and loving nature, Wolfie is the perfect companion for anyone seeking a loyal and affectionate friend. He has a calm and soothing presence, making him an ideal pet for a any household. His loving and affectionate nature means he enjoys cuddles and spending quality time with his human family. Wolfie is a delight to be around, always ready to offer a comforting nuzzle. He has been living with a Cavoodle and is good with other dogs both big and small.

NAME: Rowdy
TEXT: Meet Rowdy! The handsome social butterfly with a heart full of love and a nose for treats! This confident and friendly guy absolutely adores people and will charm his way into your heart (and maybe your snack stash) in no time. Rowdy is super trainable and eager to learn, especially if food or toys are involved – a home that is interested in furthering his training and development is ideal Rowdy is still learning the ropes when it comes to other animals, so he’s best suited as a solo dog or with another greyhound friend who can help him find his groove. He’d thrive in a home with a yard to explore and a family who can support him through his transition to pet life. With a little guidance and a lot of love, Rowdy will be the ultimate loyal companion – cheeky, charming, and full of fun. Rowdy is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet this laid-back, placid boy—our sweet male Blaze! He's the definition of a "dopey" cuddle bug who loves nothing more than a good snuggle. As a single dog household pup, he's very content with his quiet life in the backyard, and he's happy to share his space with older children who understand his calm nature. Experienced owners will appreciate his lazy demeanor and gentle temperament. He’s all about relaxing and enjoying the simple things in life!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a friendly, happy-go-lucky greyhound who’s always up for an adventure! He’s 4 1/2 years old and loves going for walks around the neighborhood, especially in suburban areas where there’s lots to sniff and explore. 🌳 This guy is also a big fan of the beach, with a special love for small shell pools—he’s happiest splashing around and enjoying the water! 🌊 Jack is great with other dogs and always ready to make new friends. His sweet, friendly nature makes him a joy to be around. Whether he’s on a walk or just chilling, Jack is sure to bring a smile to anyone he meets! 😊 If you’re looking for a fun, friendly companion who loves the outdoors, Jack is the perfect buddy for you! 🐕💖

NAME: Santa
TEXT: Santa Clause is coming to your lounge! Santa is a handsome 4 year old boy who is looking to be your perfect companion. Santa takes a little bit to warm up to new people but when he is comfortable he's the perfect mix of cuddly and playful. He loves toys! During the day Santa is perfect for full-time workers as he spends his day sleeping and playing in the backyard. By night time You'll find Santa dreaming whilst curled up on the lounge or your bed with family or your other large fluffy companion.

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Looking for a spicy, high-energy pup to add some heat to your life? With her bold confidence and zest for adventure, Pepper will keep you on your toes and bring endless fun to your days. Whether it’s a brisk walk in the park, a game of fetch, or a playful romp with her doggy friends, Pepper’s always up for action and excitement. Her enthusiasm is contagious, and there’s never a dull moment with this fiery girl around! Pepper is confident, sociable, and loves to have a good time, especially with medium to large dogs who can match her energy. If you're looking for a fun-loving, playful companion to join in your outdoor adventures and keep the excitement rolling, Pepper’s the one for you! She’s the perfect addition to an active home where she can burn off some of that spicy energy and steal your heart with her fiery personality. Ready for a hot new addition to your family? Pepper can’t wait to meet you at the Western Sydney Facility!

NAME: Maximo
TEXT: Maximo is a sporty and fun-loving greyhound with a passion for water and a heart full of love. Whether he’s splashing around in the pool or running around with his greyhound buddies, he’s always up for an active, fun time. Maximo is also fantastic with kids, having spent time with young ones and showing nothing but patience and gentleness. His easy-going nature and friendly demeanor make him a perfect fit for a family looking for a loving, playful companion. Maximo is also open to living with other dogs, especially fellow greyhounds, and has the potential to coexist with small dogs and cats with the right training and introductions, and pending a meet and greet. His calm and cooperative attitude will make him a great addition to your home. If you’re looking for a sporty, fun, and affectionate dog who’s ready to join your team, Maximo could be the perfect match! Come meet him and see why he’s ready to take your home to the next level!

NAME: Sam (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Looking for a fun-loving, people-obsessed companion? Sam the greyhound is your guy! 🐾 With his playful personality and endless enthusiasm, he’s ready to steal your heart and bring joy to every adventure. Sam is a total people pleaser, always eager for his human's attention and affection. He’s incredibly social and loves to be around his people, making him the perfect companion for anyone looking for a friendly, outgoing dog. Sam is also pro when it comes to car rides—he loves hopping in for a fun adventure and travels like a champ. Whether it’s exploring new environments or playing with his favorite toys, Sam is always up for the next exciting thing! He’s also a big fan of walks, where his playful, excitable personality shines. Sam is suitbale for living with other dogs around his size and would also be happy to share his home with older kids. If you’re looking for a fun, loving, and energetic pup to share your life with, Sam is your guy! 🐕💙 Contact the Western Sydney team to meet Sam today!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a playful, cheeky, and energetic female greyhound who loves people and is very social. She’s curious and full of fun, always ready for an adventure. With the right introduction, she might get along with smaller dogs, making her a great addition to an active and engaging home.

NAME: Collie
TEXT: Collie is a sweet older female with a calm, relaxed, and easy-going nature. She’s happy to please and would thrive in a slower-paced home. Older children are best for her, and she’s fine with smaller dogs and cats, making her a wonderful companion for a peaceful and loving household.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Billy is a sweet, affectionate, and kind natured boy. He’s loving and enjoys playing with toys, often collecting them on his bed. Billy is interactive and gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs, making him a fun and friendly companion.

NAME: Dare
TEXT: Dare is a big, gentle giant with a very sweet and playful nature. He’s fun-loving yet shows a patient and calm side when needed. Confident and happy, Dare is the perfect mix of energy and tranquility, making him an affectionate companion for any home.

NAME: Windy
TEXT: Windy is a very sweet-natured male dog who can be a little shy at first but quickly comes out of his shell, especially when playing with toys. Confident on his own, he gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is sure to bring joy and warmth once he settles in.

NAME: Hank
TEXT: Hank is a calm, easy-going, and very friendly dog with an affectionate and interactive nature. He loves to connect with others and is great with smaller breeds of dogs. Hank’s gentle personality makes him a wonderful companion for any home looking for a sweet and sociable pet.

NAME: Tom
TEXT: Tom is a happy boy who thrives on his own in a single-dog household. He needs a supportive home where he can grow and learn. With patience and encouragement, Tom will blossom into a loving and confident companion.

NAME: Scotch
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Scotch! 🖤 Scotch is a happy, confident greyhound with a heart full of joy. Due to a past leg injury, he enjoys a slower-paced home and shorter walks—but don’t worry, he can still move around and play just fine! 🐾 Engaging, affectionate, and full of love, Scotch thrives in a calm environment where he can relax and enjoy life at his own pace. If you're looking for a gentle, loyal companion, Scotch is ready to win your heart. 💕

NAME: Uno
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Uno! 🌟 Uno is a lovely older lady with a confident, engaging personality and a heart full of love. 💕 She’s sweet, kind, and always happy—bringing a warm, joyful presence wherever she goes. With her calm nature and affectionate spirit, Uno makes the perfect companion for a caring, loving family ready to share their home with a gentle soul. 🐶💫 If you’re looking for a steady, loving friend, Uno is ready to make your heart her home.

NAME: Dozer
TEXT: Dozer, or "Little D," is a sweet boy who needs time and patience to learn and grow. He’ll thrive in a quiet home where he can feel safe and supported as he blossoms into his best self. With the right care, he’s sure to become a loving companion.

NAME: Milo
TEXT: Milo is a fun-loving male greyhound with a playful and confident personality. He’s happy, sweet-natured, and kind, making him a loving companion for any home. Milo’s cheerful attitude and affectionate nature are sure to bring joy to those around him.

NAME: Lexi
TEXT: Lexi is a sweet and placid female greyhound with a calm demeanor. Eager to learn, she needs room to grow and thrive, along with patience and understanding. A single-dog household would be ideal, providing her with the space and care she needs to flourish.

NAME: Aggi
TEXT: Aggi is a pretty female greyhound who can be a little shy at first. She needs encouragement, support, love, and time to grow. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can feel secure and receive the attention she needs. Aggi is eager to learn and thrive with the right care and patience.

NAME: Micha
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Micha! 💖 Micha is a sweet and sensitive female greyhound looking for a calm, loving home to help her blossom. With the right support and encouragement, she’s eager to learn and grow into a confident companion. She’ll thrive in a quiet environment where she feels safe and secure. Micha would do best as the only dog to start with, giving her the space and attention she needs to adjust and build trust. If you have a gentle heart and a peaceful home, Micha is ready to find comfort by your side. 🐶💕

NAME: Tubby
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Tubby! 💗 Tubby is a sweet girl who just needs a little time and patience to truly shine. 🌸 She can be a bit unsure at times, but with the right support and encouragement, she’ll blossom into a loving, confident companion. She’d do best in a calm, single-dog household where she can feel safe and truly be herself. With your love and guidance, Tubby is sure to thrive. 🐶💕

NAME: Sassy
TEXT: Sassy is a female greyhound looking for a quiet, supportive, and loving home. She needs room to grow, learn, and thrive, along with the encouragement and patience to help her blossom. A single-dog household would be ideal, where she can receive all the attention and care she deserves.

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is a sweet female greyhound who can be a little shy and unsure at first, but she’ll open up with time and patience. She needs space, encouragement, and room to grow in a supportive environment. Molly thrives in a single-dog household where she can receive the love and attention she needs to feel comfortable and secure.

NAME: Minni
TEXT: Minni is a laid-back, easy-going older gal with a calm and confident demeanor. She’s curious and independent, but also affectionate and loves a good snuggle. Minni is the perfect companion for someone looking for a relaxed and loving pet.

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Lucy is a very friendly and affectionate older girl who loves to give and receive cuddles. She can be relaxed and easy-going, but also has a cheeky, playful side that adds fun to her personality. Good with smaller breeds of dogs, Lucy makes a sweet and loving companion for any home.

NAME: Banj
TEXT: Banj is a sweet, older female greyhound, ready to enjoy a relaxing retirement. She’s calm, easy-going, and laid-back, thriving in a peaceful home. Banj gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs and is comfortable around older children, making her the perfect companion for a quiet, loving household.

NAME: Snoz
TEXT: Snoz is a male greyhound with a calm and quiet demeanor. He’s patient, easy-going, and always happy, enjoying a laid-back lifestyle. With his gentle nature, he’s the perfect companion for anyone seeking a relaxed and peaceful pet. Snoz is happy to make any M/L four-legged canine his best play and can't wait to have some cuddles with his new forever family. He would suit a household with full time workers, children to play with and would be very happy to live in an apartment.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Meet Bella, a sweet, kind, and patient female greyhound who remains calm in new environments. She’s excited to play and learn, always eager for new experiences. Bella is affectionate and loves to spend time with her humans, and she gets along well with smaller breeds of dogs. She’s ready to bring her gentle spirit and enthusiasm for life to a loving home!

NAME: Nova
TEXT: Meet Nova, a beautiful and sweet female greyhound who will melt your heart once she settles into her new home. She’s affectionate and loves cuddles, and she has a playful side when it comes to toys! Nova is patient and eager to learn, making her a wonderful companion for a family who can help her continue to grow. She’s ready to share her love and brighten your life!

NAME: Bec
TEXT: Meet Bec, a playful and affectionate female greyhound who absolutely loves toys! She enjoys collecting and playing with them, and there's nothing better than a cuddle and some quality time with her humans. Bec thrives in a home with an experienced owner who can provide her with the care and attention she needs, including a backyard to run and explore. She’s grown up around children, but older kids are best for her. She’s ready to bring love and joy into a forever home!

NAME: Zac
TEXT: Meet this gentle and shy male greyhound, looking for a loving, supportive family to help him continue to grow and thrive. With a quiet nature, he enjoys the simple pleasures of life, like collecting little toys, and he responds beautifully to a gentle touch. Having grown up around small children, he’s well-suited for a family environment. An experienced dog owner would be ideal, as he’s looking for someone who can provide the patience and care he needs to flourish.

NAME: Tony
TEXT: Tony is a barrel full of laughs, love & fun! This big goof ball loves to run, play & chase. He is an active boy with a spirit to match! He would love to find a home with older active children he can run around with in the backyard. Potentially another grey or large breed of dog to play with as well. He is a confident boy who doesn't shy away from much. Tony is ready to find his perfect family! Reach out to meet him today!

NAME: Lucy
TEXT: Beautiful Lucy is lady who needs to find a supportive, patient & kind family. Lucy shows interest in wanting to be a part of a family, grow, learn how to be confident & playful, she just needs that support & encouragement to do so. A quiet home at first would be ideal. Lucy has spent time indoors, around children & a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction & supervision, Lucy may become best friends with your smaller fluff's, even your feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet Lucy :)

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Sweet Missy is a darling girl looking for her perfect family. Missy is looking for love & support from her new family in order for her shine and grow into the best version of herself. A quiet & patient home would be best. With growth, she will shine in personality & playfulness. Missy responds well to young children. She has spent time living indoors with a smaller breed of dog. With the correct introduction, Missy might become best friends with your small pups or feline family members. Please reach out if you would like to meet her :)

NAME: Alf (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Alf has just spent 2 months being a foster care super star - he's now back at the adoption centre ready to meet you!* If you're looking for a perfectly behaved boy, read on! His foster carer says "Alf is a beautiful dog not only in looks but in his temperament with humans, and is so very loveable. I have been lucky to have the pleasure of his company for two months. He is intelligent and has calmly learned a lot in his time with me. " Foster Updates: ✅Walks well on a loose lead & harness ✅Climbs stairs very well (15 stairs) ✅Travels in elevators and cars well (Car travel is more for sleeping!) ✅House trained for toileting. Impeccable manners indoors! ✅Obeys commands, come, stay, wait, yes, no, down, off. ✅Answers to name ✅Doesn't take from the bin, or destroy things ✅Trusts and loves all humans ✅Enjoys his toys ✅Can be left alone without fuss ✅Scared of thunder and lightning. Alf finds a quiet, dark room to be in for the duration. He only needs to be close – no hiding, just a little panting for this big boy. ✅Loves rolling on lawn then doing zoomies ✅Enjoys the beach ✅He knows not to be on couches or beds but given licence to do so he would love to accept ✅Visited dog parks and made friends with other dogs once he gets to know them ✅ Accepts praise and pats where ever he goes, loves all people, big, small, male, female ✅ Affectionate, gentle, a true gentleman Alf is available from our Londonderry adoption centre.

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Spot is a 2 1/2-year-old male greyhound with a heart as big as his gentle nature. He’s the quietest and most easy-going dog you’ll meet, perfect for a laid-back home or family. His friendly demeanor makes him the ideal companion for anyone looking for a calm, affectionate pet. Spot loves to lounge around and soak up all the love you can give, but he also has a playful side when the mood strikes! Why You'll Love Spot: Quiet & calm: Spot enjoys peaceful moments and doesn’t bark much, making him an ideal dog for a quieter household. Friendly & Lovable: He’s affectionate and easy to get along with, always up for cuddles and attention. Good with Small Dogs: Spot has a friendly nature and is great with smaller dogs, making him a great addition to a multi-dog home. Easy-Going Personality: Whether it’s a short walk or a cozy nap, Spot is happy to go with the flow. If you’re looking for a sweet, loving greyhound to brighten your days, Spot might just be the perfect match for you! 💕

NAME: Harvey
TEXT: Meet the sweetest senior boy, Harvey! There’s no love sweeter than the love of a senior greyhound. I'm a special greyhound that requires extra care “I must wear my booties when walking on hard or abrasive surfaces (they’ll be provided). I still enjoy my (slow) walkies, as I’m not allowed to jump or run.” Harvey's laid-back nature and medical condition make him the perfect companion for those who enjoy slow, serene walks and cosy time at home. Whether his new family are full-time workers or home more often, this low-maintenance guy will be happy either way! Harvey is a gentle 10-year-old greyhound who prefers to spend his days lounging in the sun or curled up on a soft bed, soaking in the peace and comfort of his home. He’s enjoys the company of other medium to large dogs and could be suited to a home with mature kids. Ideally, he's wishing for a home with a small yard or courtyard, where he can snooze in the warmth of the sun. (Could also be suited to a sunny apartment with lift access). Harvey is ready to find a special foster carer Angel to love him—and is waiting ever so patiently at our Londonderry Adoption Centre.

NAME: Red
TEXT: This is our boy Red. Say hello to this charming boy who is looking for his forever home. Red is relaxed on lead, great to handle, making your daily walks very enjoyable. He has had frequent exposure to leisurely strolls in town and enjoys the slow paced lifestyle. He is very friendly and will stop for pats or to say hello. At times Red can be apprehensive in new environments. Once he has found his feet, he takes the world in his stride and settles into a happy pace of life. He would suit a quieter home with any humans, big or small, that are willing to give him all of the love in the world.

NAME: Summer
TEXT: *I am in a foster care home in Newtown in the inner west - reach out to the team to find out how I'm going!* The sun is shining - Summer is finally here! Well, Summer the greyhound that is! Summer is affectionate yet independent. She doesn’t mind spending time alone, making her a great fit for a variety of lifestyles. She has also spent time around children aged 3+ making her a great fit for families. Summer is a super social and friendly girl, making her perfect for those wanting an affectionate companion. She absolutely loves people, enjoys playtime, and settles beautifully inside. Summer is learning about the world and other dogs here at the centre and is doing so well! She would benefit from ongoing training for her dog sociability but is doing well at the centre. With the right family, Summer will thrive and make a wonderful companion. So grab your hat and sunnies and get ready to enjoy this ray of sunshine, available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Stacey
TEXT: Meet our sweet girl Stacey. Stacey warms up after a little bit of attention but initially she could be weary of her surroundings. She has spent time around children and is gentle around them. Stacey is responsive on lead but will like to sniff around as well.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a gentle, lazy boy who’s mastered the art of relaxation. Living in a townhouse, he’s perfectly content with a quiet lifestyle and short daily strolls — he walks beautifully on lead and doesn’t ask for much more. He’s a sweet, old soul who spends most of his day snoozing, making him a fantastic companion for full-time workers. Jimmy thrives in calm environments and is best suited as the only dog in the home where he can enjoy all the love and attention to himself. If you’re after a low-maintenance mate who loves a cuddle and a nap more than a run in the park, Jimmy’s your guy.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Are you after a playful and cheeky friend? Benji is after his forever home! He is all things cheeky, confident and cunning. Benji is responsive on lead but some extra training wouldn't go astray. He loves a pat and to bound around a yard big or small, he would be suitable to live in a townhouse or villa and would in time be able to conquer stairs. Benji had an injury in 2023 which he has now recovered from but has a plate in his hock. If you're interested in learning more about Benji, please apply now.

NAME: Prince
TEXT: Prince is a friendly and well-mannered greyhound looking for his forever home. He’s fantastic around kids and settles well after initial excitement. He walks beautifully on a lead and has experience being around other dogs, including a small sausage dog for a short amount of time and a Labrador. Prince is an intelligent boy who will let you know when he needs something—whether it’s food or a toilet break—with a few attention barks. With a loving family and a little routine, he’ll make a wonderful companion. If you’re looking for a loyal and affectionate addition to your home, Prince might just be the perfect fit!

NAME: Gazza
TEXT: Confident, social and happy, are all great ways to describe Gazza. Gazza is social with other M-L breeds of dogs. Maaaate, he'd love to join Shazza, Bazza and Dazza on daily adventures! Gazza doesn't mind if those ankle-biters are in the home, either, more good old fun for him! Gazza would love to do his daily burn outs in the yard but will nap away on the porch once his few moments of fun are over. He's a sweet guy at heart who can't wait to find his crew! Grab a stubby and a meet Gazza at the local watering hole because this fair dinkum fella has a few yarns to tell! He can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jax (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Jax! This handsome boy is ready to find his forever home - Greeting you with a happy wagging tail and affectionate energy, Jax is sure to win over your heart in no time! Jax has had the pleasure of spending time with whippets, kids, and has been in a loving house setting, so he's already on his way to being well-versed in being a great family companion. Jax is looking for a forever family where he can offer endless affection and share his happy, friendly demeanour. If you're looking for a sweet companion to join your family, Jax might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Mo
TEXT: Gentle natured and affectionate, this senior boy will surely charm you with his adorable salt and pepper face. Mo has a lot of love to give and will share his affection with you from the moment you meet him. He has been around kids aged 1+ and would suit a home with kids who can respect his grandpa naps. Mo has shown wonderful manners with dogs big and small and is even learning about those so called "cats", too! We are hoping his forever home is full of soft beds, sunshine naps and treats...Maybe that could be you! Mo is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Meet Jimmy, a laid-back and easygoing dog with a heart full of love to give. Jimmy is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a relaxed and unflustered canine friend. Jimmy is dog who adores the simple pleasures in life, from leisurely strolls in the park to quiet evenings lounging at home. He's not one to rush through life but rather takes his time to soak in his surroundings, making every moment feel special and serene. His chilled-out nature also makes him an excellent companion for other medium to large breed dogs. If you're in search of a dog who can seamlessly integrate into a tranquil lifestyle, whether you're single, a couple, or a family, Jimmy is ready to settle in and share his companionship with you. Get ready for leisurely adventures and cozy evenings with this loving and relaxed furry friend.

NAME: Paddy
TEXT: Mr Paddy! This gentle giant is such an easy-going, laid-back goof ball! He is always down to clown or just take it easy and rest his feet. He gets on well with smaller breeds of dogs- there's a Yorkie always saying hello :) Paddy interacts positively with new people, even younger children. He would love to have yard where he can run about, chasing toys thrown by his new best friends :)

NAME: Skip
TEXT: Meet Skip, the happy and friendly boy. This loyal and loving dog is always ready to greet you warmly and share a moment, no matter how small. Not only does Skip adore people, but he's also a social butterfly with other dogs, making him an incredible addition to multi-dog households. This charming canine companion will enrich your life with his unwavering loyalty and snuggles. Whether it’s a hike through the woods or a cozy night at home, Skip is just happy to be by your side, providing companionship, laughter, and unconditional love. If you're looking for a furry friend who always wears a smile and offers boundless affection, Skip might just be the perfect companion for your household.

NAME: Scout
TEXT: Meet Scout, a gentle soul of a dog. Scout is an easy-going companion, ready to fill your days with quiet affection and steadfast loyalty. His presence is soothing and his love is unconditional, offering the perfect balance in a fast-paced world. Scout's relaxed nature makes him the ideal partner for leisurely walks around the neighborhood or peaceful afternoons spent lounging in the backyard. He's more than content to curl up at your feet, providing the kind of quiet companionship that warms the heart. Scout would like a quiet home where is gets lots of love and affection. Scout has met cats and would settle with proper introduction and a calm easy going cat.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear, the ultimate embodiment of relaxation and tranquility wrapped up in a big, huggable package. This calm and easygoing canine companion resembles a giant teddy bear. Bear's favourite pastime is napping. Whether it's a lazy afternoon snooze on the patio or stretching out for a long, cozy rest beside you on the couch, Bear knows how to unwind like no other. While he might not be the most active pup on the block, Bear’s delightful charm lies in his serene nature. He's the perfect partner for a quiet afternoon reading session or watching a movie at home. Bear also enjoys a short walk around the block where he can have a sniff and explore Bear would thrive in a home where he can enjoy a relaxed lifestyle. While he may be big in size, his heart and loveable nature are even bigger.

NAME: Dora
TEXT: Pleased to introduce you to the wonderful Dora! Dora is a senior lady looking to share her love with a new family. Dora has spent time living with a young family for approx 12 months & is now ready to find her forever home. She loves young children. Very patient & calm with them. Dora is gentle, kind & affectionate. Engaging in sweet cuddles & kisses. Dora may adapt to living on her own or in an apartment. Confident & content, she might well adapt to full-time workers as well :)

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Looking for a sweetheart that loves children, engaging in fun play & snuggling? Then Millie is the girl for you! Millie is very excitable & playful! Loves to run around being a little silly & cheeky. Quick to jump in a body of water.... even on picture day hehe :)

NAME: Harley
TEXT: Meet Harley, a cheerful and easygoing companion. This friendly fella has a personality that's as warm as the summer sun, making him an ideal addition to any family seeking a loyal, loving dog. Harley has a delightful, laid-back nature about him. He is effortlessly sociable, having met small dogs with a friendly yet disinterested attitude, ready to just hang out and enjoy their company without demanding constant interaction. With his infectious happiness and calm, affectionate personality, Harley promises to be a wonderful companion for anyone seeking a peaceful, friendly presence in their life. If you’re ready to welcome an easygoing and friendly buddy into your life, Harley is more than ready to meet you. Harley has now been introduced to cats and would be suitable for a home with a confident indoor cat who likes dogs.

NAME: Storm
TEXT: Relaxed & very loving older lady. Has spent time around grandchiildren. Storm is a confident girl looking for a life of leisure. She will do well on her own, with full time workers..... or if you might consider welcoming 2 beautiful ladies into your life, Storm’s sister, Chucky is also available :)

NAME: Chucky
TEXT: Sweet & adorable older gal. Independant & confident. Will adpat to full time workers. Has spent time around young grandchildren. Relaxed in new spaces & around new people. Sister to Storm! Would you consider welcoming both into your family?

NAME: Garnet
TEXT: **Garnet has lived in a foster home in the city CBD with full time workers, is affectionate and intelligent, and loves long walkies and would enjoy an active family to keep fit and go on daily adventures with** She's been a joy to foster! Here's a glimpse into Garnet's wonderful traits: - Garnet is an early bird who enjoys morning naps after joining you in bed. - A fearless adventurer, she's unbothered by much and walks in loud, busy city streets. - Walks in the rain without hesitation. - Patiently waits outside shops while you run quick errands. - Curious by nature, Garnet follows you around, eager to be part of your activities. - Loves to relax and roach on the couch. - Enjoys chasing Frisbees, balls, and playing with squeaky toys. - An exceptional office companion and assistant. - Incredibly friendly and affectionate, she welcomes pats from everyone she meets. - Gentle with children she meets. - Gets super excited about snacks, especially denta sticks! - Loves to taste a variety of foods, from peanut butter, hot chips, and banana. - Garnet has accompanied professional dog walkers, who have consistently praised how well she walks on the lead. Garnet has been a delight in the home, and I'm sure she'll make an excellent addition to a loving family. We’ll certainly miss her! If you're looking for a dog to fill your home with love and joy then apply to adopt the gorgeous Garnet today!

NAME: Rissole
TEXT: Rissole is a handsome blue boy. Described as a happy, cheerful bubbly boy, we think he could live with older kids and would be content with a courtyard or backyard to call his own. He can be shy when you first get to know him, so a home who enjoy bringing a dog out of their shell will be the best fit for this pretty boy. We have noticed he is more confident around other hounds, and would suit a home with another doggie pal, but not a requirement. He is looking for a quiet loving home - could it be you? Rissole is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Pattie
TEXT: Meet Pattie, a gentle and gracious senior who has spent her life expertly spreading love and warmth. Pattie has been in the company of children and copes well with if they are polite and well mannered. Pattie is a well-mannered lady who carries herself with a polite serenity, she has been socialised with small dogs and although she would prefer a large companion she is polite around small dogs. Pattie has slowed in her senior years, but she would love a foster home where she can settle and would be the perfect companion for someone looking for an older calm companion.

NAME: Eve
TEXT: Meet Eve, a gentle and calm senior lady who's ready to grace your home with her presence. With her quiet and serene nature, Eve is the epitome of tranquility, and she effortlessly brings a sense of peace wherever she roams. Eve has a friendly disposition and a soulful gaze that speaks volumes. She's an observant girl who appreciates the simpler things in life, making her a suitable match for a loving individual or family seeking a mellow furry friend. As a senior dog, Eve would thrive in a foster home where she can enjoy her golden years in comfort. Her dream environment would be one filled with love, where she can relax while being treasured as the devoted companion she is. By welcoming Eve into your life, you'll not only be providing her with a secure and loving home, but you'll also be rewarded with the companionship of a truly special and lovable friend.

NAME: Arthur (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *I'm currently in a foster home* And I say HEY! What a wonderful kind of day. If you can learn to work and play and get along with Arthur the greyhound! Arthur is a total cutie pie. He is the star of the show, much like the 90's show! Arthur would enjoy a home with a big or small dog. He is a shy boy at heart, but loves smooches and cuddles once you get to know him. A backyard or courtyard would be suitable but he can also live in an apartment home as he enjoys settling quietly indoors and can do stair cases. He walks on a loose lead, as well as learning some training cues like 'on your bed' and 'off your bed'... Talk about talented! It's a simple message and it comes from the heart, Believe in this (and in Arthur the greyhound) for that's the place to start! Arthur is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cookie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Cookie is a friendly & social girl looking for her new home where she will be surrounded by love and attention! She’s very human-focused and loves being around people, always displaying positive consent and gentle affection. Whether it’s playtime or cuddle time, she’s sure to brighten your day! Cookie does very well walking calmly on a lead, making walks a relaxed and enjoyable experience. She’s also shown to be good around our other greyhounds, and could be happy sharing her new home with another medium/large doggie friend - Pending a Meet & Greet at our Western Sydney site. Contact us today to learn more about this lovely girl and discuss booking in an appointment to meet her!

NAME: Wynstan
TEXT: Wynstan with a Y here...let me tell you a bit about myself! I hope you like a happy affectionate boy, if so, read on! I love to lean on my handlers and show off my adorable affectionate nature. Did anyone tell you I'm also polite with big and small dogs? Seriously, I'm a catch! I'm also all about my treats, so if you're looking to teach me tricks, please involve snacks too! This will help me settle in and learn how to be the best pet for you. Everyone says I'm amazing, so I guess they love how I walk so nicely and gently on the lead for walkies, too! I'm available from the Western Sydney adoption centre, see you soon!

NAME: Paul
TEXT: Paul is a stunning boy who is great to play with, can be left alone. He is social and confident with other dogs and a good walker on the lead. He enjoys a coffee date and a trip to Bunning's on the weekends! Paul would suit a household with children or any age, full-time workers, a backyard or with other pups to play with.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is currently in a foster home with his sister Katie. We have loved getting to know Ace and giving him the opportunity to enjoy his new life as a pet. Affectionally known to us as our ‘Sookie Lala’, Ace just wants to be by your side 24/7. He loves being close and seeing what things you are getting up to throughout your day. He also loves the outdoor (and indoor) couch and will happily settle in there for the day when outside. Ace will bounce happily on his toes when we come home and loves a hug and cuddle. We are teaching him how to play fetch and he really enjoys being included in any play time activities. He is toilet trained and sleeps very well throughout the night. Ace walks wonderfully on a leash as he likes to be right by your side. He doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small and is very friendly to other small dogs and children. If you have love to give and are looking for a dog to soak it all in – Ace is your boy! ______________________________________________________________________________ Ace is a playful and gentle hound. He was very friendly and nice when he met my daughter and was good company with a good balance of being playful and affectionate. Gets along great with other greyhounds. Currently fostered in a suburban home and getting comfy coming inside the house and loving the backyard.

NAME: Katie
TEXT: Katie is currently in a foster home with her brother Ace. We have loved getting to know Katie and giving her the opportunity to enjoy her new life as a pet. Being the older sister, she is very independent and settles very easily. She is very happy to sit on her bed whilst you work or go about your day. She is toilet trained and has fallen into her new routine very easily. She gets so excited to see us, as exemplified with her happy, whipping tail (duck for cover!). She tends to jump up on you when she’s very excited, but this is something we are working on and have already seen great improvements on. Katie walks well on a leash and doesn’t react negatively to other dogs, big or small. She has done well approaching small dogs and children and saying hello. Katie would be a great pet for a someone looking for an independent dog that will also shower you will love and affection. __________________________________________________________________________ Katie is a lovely hound. She is happy and confident, very playful. Does appreciate a good lay down also. Has been living in a rural setting is no stranger to native animals and is now in suburban foster care enjoying cuddly toys, living out the back and coming in the home for the evening.

NAME: Flash
TEXT: **I'm in a foster home** Flash is seeking an empathetic & nurturing owner who can follow a cooperative care plan to help with his daily eye medication. Could you be the perfect owner for our sweet boy? Flash has advanced pannus, which means he needs daily eye medication. But don’t worry—he’s a star pupil when it comes to taking his meds & he’s getting better every day with the right guidance. Flash is currently learning all sorts of new tricks at the adoption centre. He is a fast learner and with a little time and practice, he's shown he can do amazing things. A large yard where Flash can stretch his legs and zoom around is a must! He loves a good run, and a big space is perfect for his energy. No small children or other animals. Flash would prefer a calm environment where he can be the only one getting your attention and affection. Flash is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. **Flash is on daily medication - enquire with GAP for more info**

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Meet Spot, our distinguished older gentleman who is looking for the perfect match. Spot isn't just any dog; he carries himself with the grace and ease that only a seasoned greyhound can. Spot has had the pleasure of living in the serene setting of a granny flat, making him an expert in enjoying the quieter side of life. However, don’t let his age fool you; thanks to a thorough training program, Spot is sharp and responsive. He comes eagerly when his name is called and possesses a well-mannered set of tricks, including "touch" and "paws up," that make him a delight to teach and interact with. His training, combined with his naturally loyal temperament, makes Spot an excellent fit for a single person looking for a true companion. He understands the comforting routine of a single household and offers unwavering loyalty in return. Spot embodies the best qualities of an older dog. Devoted and endearing, he is ready to join someone who values thoughtful companionship and has room in their heart for a truly dignified and loving friend.

NAME: Chandler
TEXT: Meet sweet & beautiful Chandler... Chandler is a gentle and polite male greyhound with a calm and relaxed demeanor. He’s a sweetheart who greets everyone warmly and enjoys a good snuggle, especially after a sunbath. Chandler has been around older kids and medium-sized dogs, and he gets along well with both. He’s also a joy to walk on a lead, making him the perfect companion for leisurely strolls. Whether lounging in the sun or curled up for some quiet time, Chandler is sure to bring a sense of calm and affection to any home.

NAME: Sting
TEXT: Get ready to feel the Sting of love from this handsome boy! With his confident personality and loving nature, Sting is ready to take on the world, whether it’s playing in the backyard or having a cuddle session. Sting would thrive with an owner who can match his energy and provide plenty of love and attention. He would be open to sharing his new home with another furry friend, pending a meet & greet with the GAP team. He also has the potential to work up to longer hours alone, but would like he family or another furry companion with him to help settle in the early stages. If you’re looking to welcome a dog who’s full of personality and ready to make your life even more exciting, Sting might be the one for you!

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Benji is currently in a foster home with another senior, medium-sized dog and being the best boy! 🐾 If you think you could give this sweet soul his forever home, apply to meet him at our Western Sydney Adoption Centre! Meet Benji – the sweet, playful gentleman with a heart full of love. While Benji may be nearing his senior years, don’t let that fool you — he’s still full of fun and charm! He’d thrive in a home with a courtyard or backyard, where he can spend his days sunbaking and playing to his heart’s content. Benji has lived with children of all ages and could happily join a home with mature kids who can appreciate his enthusiastic nature. If you’re looking for a loyal companion to fill your days with happiness, Benji is ready to meet you and join your family.

NAME: Jax
TEXT: Jax is a fun young hound who likes to play go for walks and enjoys a good rest afterwards. He lives in a suburban backyard and is conditioned to being left alone during full time work hours. He comes when called and enjoys a walk. Jax would suit living with full time workers with a backyard or a busy family.

NAME: Midas
TEXT: Gentle, calm and a lovely walking companion, Midas will add the glitz and gold to your life. Midas is an affectionate and gentle boy, who shines with attention and love. He would prefer his family around more this summer as he settles in, and with further training could be left for longer hours. Everything he touches will turn to gold...he is a friendly and calm boy looking for a family with or without children to love him forever! Midas is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billson
TEXT: Bubbly, effervescent and a perfect accompaniment for your life (not only this summer!), Billson is a sweet and joyful hound. He has been around children of all ages and would suit a home with respectful children. A low small dog population is the best fit for Billson as he needs to learn and have more training around them. Upbeat and fun, Billson would suit many home types. He's an energetic lad with some energy to fizz away, so a home with the family members around more often than not would be the best fit for Billson. Grab a slab and join Billson this summer! He is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: This adorable boy is the sweetest little guy ever! Teddy is great with other medium/large sized dogs and would happily join a family who already has one and spend the day with them while his humans are out. As a single dog, Teddy has shown to cope well on his own. Older, respectful kids are suitable for Teddy and would enjoy his goofy playfulness! So come and cuddle our little Teddy today! He is available from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Raffa
TEXT: This bundle of joy loves human interaction and adventure. Raffa loves to run around his big yard area and shows you how fast he can be. Raffa gets very excited for the first five minutes you meet him before settling down. After getting his morning energy out and jumping around Raffa settles down and loves to lay in the sun. Raffa is fine around older kids and would make a great pet for a family with a big yard or a young couple who are fit and active.

NAME: Ronald
TEXT: Ronald is a cheerful, confident and friendly lad looking to bounce straight into your home. We know Ronald to be a charismatic, charming and affectionate boy. With these qualities in mind, we think he'd suit a family with children and preferably shorter hours alone while he begins to settle in. This beautiful boy is at the magical age of 6 where he has his lazy side but has moments of playfulness, too. A perfect blend for many family types! Did we mention he currently lives with another greyhound? He'd love it if you had another hound for a play mate and nap buddy. Get in touch with the Western Sydney centre to meet Ronald.

NAME: Jagger
TEXT: He’s got the moves like Jagger! This boy certainly knows how to impress! Jagger is a special boy with a personality that can melt your heart. Jagger has a laid-back and easy-going nature, making him suited a home that has a secure backyard/courtyard type environment. Jagger can adapt to a household where family members work full-time, as long as he receives the love and attention he deserves when they return home. Providing him with a comfortable space and engaging toys during the day can help keep him content. Due to his sweet nature, he is an ideal choice for a home with respectful children seeking a loving companion. He has shown to be polite with other medium to large canine companions. He is a social boy and enjoys the companion of his four-legged friends, if you have other dogs in the home, he will surely enjoy showing them his moves! Be sure to apply online today and mention Jagger’s name in your application, you don’t want to miss out on welcoming this loving, gentle and playful boy to your home.

NAME: Costa
TEXT: Meet Cuddle Me Costa, a sweet and affectionate male greyhound who lives up to his name with big, warm cuddles! Costa is a confident, happy boy who loves to shower his family with love. He’s well-socialized with young children and medium-sized dogs, making him a perfect fit for family life. Costa is equally content doing his own thing or hanging out with the family, whether it’s relaxing on the couch or enjoying a quiet moment outdoors. With his loving nature and laid-back attitude, Costa is sure to bring joy and comfort to your home.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Rocky is a friendly and easy-going male greyhound who loves socializing with young children and other medium-sized dogs. This laid-back fellow is happy to go with the flow, whether it’s enjoying a quiet moment at home or joining in on family activities. Rocky is a calm and adaptable companion, making him an ideal choice for a family looking for a well-mannered dog who’s great with kids and other pets. His gentle nature and relaxed attitude mean he’s content to simply be part of the family and enjoy whatever life brings his way.

NAME: Jay Jay
TEXT: Say g’day to JayJay this beautiful female has had a wonderful life around children as young as 1 year old and also around Medium dogs. Jayjay is 5 years of age and is a perfect mix between puppy playful during the day and settled mature girl of a night. Jay jay is always excited to go for a walk and would be the perfect dog for someone looking at undertaking adventures and longer walks Jayjay travels well in a car and would love a backyard to play the day away in

NAME: Baby
TEXT: Nobody puts baby in the corner! This little lady is looking to learn all about the world with you! She would suit short hours alone as a solo girl, or longer hours with a canine companion. Polite with dogs big or small, beautiful Baby has so much love to give and is searching for the right place to call home. If this Baby girl sounds like the perfect addition to your family, apply to take her home from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is a wonderfully sweet nature and a calm temperament. Bear's calm demeanor makes him an ideal partner for leisurely strolls, as he's quite responsive on a lead. Whether you're taking a walk in the park or simply exploring your local neighborhood, Bear's company will surely make your day brighter. His gentle pace and attentive nature are perfect for anyone seeking a serene and steady walking buddy.

NAME: Clyde
TEXT: Meet Clyde, the charming socialite of the dog world! This happy-go-lucky greyhound is always ready to make new friends and engage with anyone he meets. His confidence shines as he approaches life with a tail wag and a friendly demeanor that wins over hearts immediately. Clyde absolutely adores ear scratches, and you’ll find him happily leaning in for more attention whenever he gets the chance. Whether he's meeting new people or hanging out with his greyhound buddies, Clyde is always the life of the party, making sure everyone feels welcome and included.

NAME: Ivanka
TEXT: Meet Ivanka, a playful and excited lady with a heart full of affection! This happy female greyhound is ready to bring joy and energy to your home. Playful and affectionate. Loves to give a classic Greyhound lean and cuddle. Social with larger dogs and open to learning to love smaller canine friends. Enjoys active playtime and engaging walks. Thrives in a lively environment where she can express her playful spirit. A loving and active household that can keep up with her playful nature. Suitable for families or individuals who appreciate a happy, energetic companion. If you’re looking for a lively and loving companion, Ivanka would be thrilled to meet you! Reach out for more information or to schedule a visit.

NAME: Hunter
TEXT: Meet Hunter, a gentle soul with a heart full of loyalty and companionship to offer. While he may be a tad shy when you first meet him, it doesn't take long for his affectionate personality to shine through. Hunter is an exemplary walker on a lead, showing politeness and attentiveness on each stroll. He won't pull or rush, making daily walks together a serene and enjoyable experience. He thrives in the presence of someone who understands his need for trust-building and who will cherish the meaningful connection he creates with his human family members. While he is happiest in a quiet home environment, Hunter's devotion is unwavering once he gets to know you. With his poised and loyal spirit, Hunter will be by your side as a faithful friend, ready to share life's simple pleasures. If you are looking for a devoted companion who values walks and quiet time alike, Hunter could be your perfect match, offering companionship and loyalty in the most endearing way.

NAME: Foxy
TEXT: Meet our little Foxy girl, a sweet natured girl who would love a family who is happy to take a slower approach while she learns the ropes of being a pet. Foxy is playful, excitable and engaging. She loves to show you her fluffy toys and will happily entertain herself! Foxy is a happy traveler and will be happy to follow you wherever you're off to. She would benefit from leash training, as she can be quite excited going to new places and meeting new people.

NAME: Irena
TEXT: Are you ready to be laughing with your newest furry friend? Well, Irena will have you cackling. She is a true definition of a little pocket rocket, she will be showing all aspects of her zoomies and how confident she is in doing so. Irena enjoys spending her days showing off and basking in the sunshine. She is loves companionship and will happily follow you anywhere you desire. Irena knows her name well and with a little bit of getting used to your voice she will come (running) straight back.

NAME: Ralph
TEXT: Are you after a little fire-cracker in your life? Look no further than our boy Ralph! He is all things active/fun-loving and absolutely hilarious; Ralph will have your grinning from ear to ear. Ralph would suit an active family with a backyard who can walk him daily and throw his favourite toy around, Ralph hasn't been exposed to an indoor setting as yet so may take some time adjusting but I think he will happily follow you around. His favourite game is showing his friends how quick his zoomies are so a nice backyard will do the trick so he can show off to you. If you're interested in hearing more about Ralph, please apply now.

NAME: Lou
TEXT: *Lou has just stepped paws into a foster care home in a unit/apartment - check in soon for updates!* Friendly, charismatic boy Lou ticks all the boxes! This fun loving goofy guy is going to make an amazing pet! We love spending time with this affectionate, toy loving boy. Here's why we love him: ✅ Full time workers ✅ Apartment living ✅ Respectful kids ✅ Medium to large doggie friends ✅ Affectionate boy with a playful side Apply now to meet Lou from our Western Sydney program!

NAME: Darren
TEXT: Meet Darren, a super laid-back sort of boy, who is happy just to be around his humans, he doesn't ask for much but a pat here and there would strike a bonus. He's happy to explore alone or go for leisurely strolls, you would rarely even hear him bark. Darren enjoys going to school pick up to collect his human- brother who is 12yo and all the kids love to dote on him. If you're interested in knowing more about Darren, please apply now!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: Meet our big boy Bruce! He is a true delight to be around. He will make you laugh until you cackle. He will be happy to cruise around with you day in and out. He is a gorgeous character to boasts confidence. Bruce suffered a racing injury and required surgery on his front right leg so an experienced owner who knows when to slow down on the zoomies is ideal.

NAME: Chum
TEXT: Meet Chum, the epitome of easy-going and affection! This boy has a sweet personality that instantly wins over hearts. Chum is as laid back as they come. He loves nothing more than being close to his human friends. He's a responsive walker on leash, making strolls in the park or through the neighbourhood a pleasant experience for everyone involved. He naturally exudes confidence, thriving in a variety of social environments, especially around younger children. Chum is not just a pet; he's a loving family member, always eager to make new friends and share in the joys of everyday life. With his friendly disposition and ability to seamlessly fit into any family dynamic, Chum is ready to bring his special warmth and companionship to his new home.

NAME: Moses
TEXT: Are you after a dog to be totally besotted by you? Well meet Moses, a quirky and loveable boy whose after his forever home. Moses boasts confidence and is extremely gentle in his approach. He has been around children 4+ and will request frequent pats. He has been brought up with a jack russel at home, but would benefit from a meet and greet prior to being adopted. Moses will be attending our Adoption Day at Glandore Wines on the 5th of October.

NAME: Stumpy
TEXT: This sociable fellow is a joy to be around and has a knack for bringing smiles to everyone he meets. Stumpy is a social butterfly, especially when it comes to other greyhounds. He thrives in the company of his fellow canines and enjoys the camaraderie of a playful group. If you have other greyhounds or are involved in a greyhound community, Stumpy will fit in seamlessly and form bonds quickly. This gentle dog is well-socialized with children aged nine years and up, making him a wonderful family pet. Whether it's a leisurely stroll in the park or lounging around at home, Stumpy is adaptable and easygoing. Stumpy is not just a pet; he's a loving and loyal friend ready to enrich your life with joy and companionship.

NAME: Spot
TEXT: Spot is independent and enjoys spending time roaming around. Spot would suit a family who is after a companion to cruise around the backyard with. At times Spot can be weary and a bit timid in new environments but with the right re-assurance, she recovers really well. If you're interested in meeting our darling Spot, please apply now.

NAME: Felix
TEXT: Felix is the card you've been hoping to draw! This interesting lad is definitely personality plus, if not a little odd - in an endearing and adorable way of course! ✅ Absolutely loves people! Both the giving and receiving attention side of it! ✅ Travels very well in the car - so no excuse, he can attend your road trips! ✅ Such a community hero, Felix is a blood donor. ✅ Clever Felix comes to his name - we're not going to lie, he won't come if he doesn't feel like it. But he does know you're calling him 😎 ✅ At only 28.5kg, Felix is quite small for a male greyhound ✅ Felix has been spending time inside his current home - and loving the luxuries of pet life! ✅ Felix is crate trained and could live in an apartment (you'll be pleased to know he is very clean in his crate!) ✅ Loves his toys! So can be easily entertained with some toys he can call his own. ✅ Felix loves the water so get ready for some pool time, beach time, pond time - whatever water time you can offer him! ✅ Felix is happy to either be the only fur baby in your life, or could live with a female dog (he is a bit funny with other males...) - He would still need very slow, gradual introductions to any new dogs. ✅ Felix is good with children. Disclaimer: he's big and likes to hog most of the couch space! ✅ Enjoys playing, having fun, and just living his best life ✅ He can be exuberant and boisterous to start (oh my god life is so exciting!!) - but he does settle and eventually wants to find a lounge. ✅ Has been living inside his current home everyday - and is becoming quite accustomed to the spoils of pet life! ✅ Like most men, Toby LOVES his food! This will help with training as he is very easily influenced when free food is on offer! ✅ This patient boy settles when in the car or trailer ✅ Best suited as the only dog in the household - more attention for Toby 😉 ✅ The only hound Toby wouldn't mind sharing his new forever home with is his sister-from-another-mister: Winnie (Microchip: 956000009482109). - They currently live inside together and don't mind sharing all the love and attention. - Winnie is also available for adoption: https://www.gapnsw.com.au/our-greyhounds/winnie-2 Toby will need a bit of time to settle into his new home - it's a big transition moving to a new house. But with a bit of love and patience, you will be rewarded with a sweet, but funny, but lovable larrikin. Toby hasn't had the chance to interact with children yet. So would need a nice meet and greet to see how everybody goes, if potentially going into a home with kids. He is a big strong boy so likely would be best with older children. This sturdy lad is strong on lead - there's a big world out there and oh so little time, Toby feels like he must concur it stat! He does settle, and with a little training and patience will be a good walking companion or social wing man. Toby will be 6 at the end of January! Nothing bonds a family and new boy better than a birthday party right?!

NAME: Lucky
TEXT: BOO!! Just kidding, it's in Lucky aka Phantom Ghost's nature to be a bit of a mysterious jokester! But don't be spooked by his former Race Name "Phantom Ghost" - as he is also Lucky! And you'll be feeling lucky too punk once you have our Lucky in your life: ✅ Very happy chap who somehow looks like he's always smiling! ✅ Loves people! He will give ample affection - but secretly hopes he gets it in return too! ✅ Has interacted with other dogs: - Regularly interacts with other Greyhounds - Has met a little West Highland Terrier and Italian Greyhound. Lucky was a little pushy to start but did settle once the novelty wore off. - He would be suited to other Medium-Large breed dogs - Lucky will need very slow, patient, and gradual introductions when meeting any new dogs ✅ Good with older children: - Lucky has only interacted with older kids - He can excited however (new friends! new friends!) and jump. Once he is told No he will settle. Continued training with this will help him learn. Lucky has lived in a kennel environment all of his life, so hopes his new family understand he will need a little time and patience to settle into his new world. If you think you should be so lucky, enquire about our Lucky aka "Phantom Ghost" below!

NAME: Tori
TEXT: Looking to spruce up your abode? We have some styling tips: Simply add the stunning Tori aka "Rattlin' Style" into your house! You'll be all the fashion and talk of the town! This strikingly elegant and beautiful girl has other lovely qualities too: ✅ Very affectionate little lady who thrives on human companionship. ✅ Good with older children: - Tori currently interacts with children aged 6+years old - She is relaxed and calm around older kids. She recognizes their gentle and caring presence, and her natural instincts guide her to be extra gentle and patient. - Tori is the kind of dog who will offer a warm nuzzle or a gentle paw to her young humans, ensuring an unbreakable bond. ✅ Tori is a good, polite girl in her kennel. ✅ This clever lass has an understanding of appropriate conduct and is respectful of boundaries. ✅ Good with Medium-Large breed dogs: - Regularly interacts with other Greyhounds. - Tori interacts best with male Greyhounds. - She would need very slow, gradual introductions to any new dogs. ✅ Tori loves her toys! Watching her play is a joy in itself. Her evident fun and energy is contagious! - so both Tori and you can have a grand old time! Tori will need a fully fenced yard. Tori can sometimes Resource Guard her food, so it is best if she is fed separately and left alone to eat her dins. If having a devoted dame in your life sounds like a pretty picture, then Enquire or Apply to Adopt Tori (Rattlin' Style) to style up your home 😉 She may just improve your life and happiness too!

NAME: Bago
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Bago, the Stylish Black Greyhound in Search of His Perfect Home! 🐾 Hey there, awesome folks! I'm Bago, a fashionable black Greyhound with a heart full of love, on the lookout for my forever family. I'm all about cozying up on a couch to call my own. Just imagine me, the epitome of style, lounging in comfort, and enjoying every moment of relaxation. Having a spot to call mine would be a dream come true! When it comes to making new friends, I'm a social butterfly. Meeting new people brings me so much joy, and I can't wait to shower you with affection. Let's embark on incredible adventures together and create a bond that'll last a lifetime. Now, I'm eagerly waiting to find my forever home, where I can show off my impeccable fashion sense and bring endless love and warmth to your life. Are you ready to welcome Bago, the stylish black Greyhound boy, into your heart? 🐾 Bago is ready to bring love, style, and a whole lot of snuggles to your home sweet home! 🐾

NAME: Caeden
TEXT: Hi everyone my name is Caeden. As you can see I'm a beautiful brindle boy looking for my perfect home. I am quite an active boy so my ideal home would be to someone who doesn't mind exercising me and spending a bit of time keeping me occupied. I am an alert boy and I like to know what is happening around me. I love socialising with my current family and am used to children and some other dogs. I am smart, well mannered and would love to join you in the adventures of life! I'd love to meet you and become your best mate.

NAME: Scamp
TEXT: Hi my name is Scamp! As my name suggests I am a mischievous but likeable boy (a big goof really). I am not naughty but just a bit of a character. I love playing and getting stirred up, I will run around and engage in play with you. I am a big boy with a big roman nose which may not appeal to everyone but I think I'm pretty handsome! I do enjoy a bit of exercise so someone a little active or an active family with older children would be perfect. I enjoy people and getting attention, am happy go lucky and would make a great companion, all I need is a chance! If you are interested in adopting or even fostering me apply and the team at GAP can organise a meet and greet.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Just like his namesake in the movies Rocky could be your favorite underdog! Rocky is outgoing and friendly, loves pats and being spoilt by his human companions. He would suit a home that is moderately active as he likes a bit of a run and zoom around the yard. Rocky will really bond with his new owner and become a loyal companion. He has been socialised with his little pug friend but does require a little time when meeting new friends. If you have a bit of time for a new friend and are looking for a diamond in the rough apply to meet Rocky today!
